title: Trump says Iran war talks taking place during lull in strikes
english: President Trump has expressed optimism regarding peaceful negotiations with Iran following a three-day pause in hostilities. While he hopes these discussions will end the conflict, he warned that military actions will resume if diplomatic efforts fail. Despite reports of ammunition shortages, the administration maintains that the U.S. military remains well-equipped to meet its strategic goals.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ላለፉት ሶስት ቀናት የውጊያ መቆም መታየቱን ተከትሎ፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል በመካሄድ ላይ ስላሉት ድርድሮች ተስፋ ሰጪ አስተያየት ሰጥተዋል። እነዚህ የሰላም ውይይቶች ካልተሳኩ አሜሪካ እንደገና ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ እንደምትገደድ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን የአሜሪካ የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት እያለቀ ነው የሚሉ ዘገባዎች ቢኖሩም፣ የኋይት ሀውስ አስተዳደር ሀገሪቱ ለወታደራዊ ግቦቿ በቂ የሆነ መሳሪያ እንዳላት አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Tiraamp giddu galeessa Iran fi Ameerikaatti guyyoota sadan darban waraanni dhaabbachuu isaatiin walqabatee, mariin nageenyaa jalqabamuu isaa fi abdii akka qaban ibsaniiru. Mariin kun yoo milkaa'uu baate garuu, Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa garaatti deebisuuf akka dirqamtu akeekkachiisaniiru. Gabaasawwan meeshaan waraanaa Ameerikaa dhumaa jiraachuu eeran jiraatanis, mootummaan Ameerikaa meeshaalee gahaa ta'e akka qaban mirkaneessaniiru.

title: US singer D4vd to go on trial for murder in death of teen
english: A Los Angeles judge has ordered musician David Anthony Burke, known as D4vd, to stand trial for the murder and sexual abuse of a 14-year-old girl. Prosecutors claim the 21-year-old artist killed the victim after she threatened to expose their relationship and ruin his music career. The teen's remains were discovered in a vehicle linked to the singer, who has entered a plea of not guilty.
amharic: የሎስ አንጀለስ ዳኛ ዴቪድ አንቶኒ በርክ ወይም በስሙ D4vd የሚታወቀው አሜሪካዊ ድምጻዊ በ14 ዓመቷ ታዳጊ ላይ በፈጸመው ግድያ እና ወሲባዊ ጥቃት ክስ እንዲመሰረትበት ወስነዋል። አቃቤ ህጎች እንደሚሉት፣ የ21 ዓመቱ ድምጻዊ ታዳጊዋ ስለ ግንኙነታቸው ለሰዎች እንደምትናገር እና ሙያውን እንደምታበላሽ በማስፈራራቷ ነው የገደላት። የተጎጂዋ አስከሬን ዘፋኙ ከሚኖርበት አድራሻ ጋር በተያያዘ መኪና ውስጥ የተገኘ ሲሆን፣ ተጠርጣሪው ጥፋተኛ አለመሆኔን በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa Los Angeles, muuziqeessaa David Anthony Burke ykn D4vd jedhamee beekamu, intala waggaa 14 irratti ajjeechaa fi miidhaa saalaa raawwate jedhamee himannaan irratti akka banamu murteesseera. Himannaan abbaa alangaa akka ibsutti, umriin isaa 21 kan ta'e sirbitichi, intaltiin kun hariiroo isaanii saaxiluufi hojii muuziqaa isaa mancaasuun waan isa doorsifteef akka ajjeese himatameera. Reeffi intalattii konkolaata isa waliin walqabatu keessatti kan argame yoo ta'u, inni garuu yakka kana akka hin raawwanne dubbachuun himannicha haaleera.

title: Video shows man subdued after stabbing three women in Paris
english: A man was arrested in Paris after stabbing three women near Porte de Clichy. Two of the victims suffered serious injuries, but bystanders and an off-duty police officer were able to restrain the attacker. Authorities are still investigating the reason behind this violent assault.
amharic: በፓሪስ በፖርቴ ደ ክሊቺ አካባቢ ሶስት ሴቶችን በቢላ የቆሰለ አንድ ሰው በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። ከጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሁለቱ ሴቶች ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ቢሆንም፣ በቦታው የነበሩ ሰዎች እና ከስራ ውጪ የነበሩ አንድ ፖሊስ ጥቃት አድራሹን መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። የጥቃቱ ምክንያቱ እስካሁን በግልጽ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Namichi tokko Paarisitti, naannoo Porte de Clichy jedhamutti dubartoota sadii waraannee qabameera. Dubartoota midhaan irra ga'e keessaa lama haala hamaa keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, namoonni achi turanii fi poolisiin hojii irra hin turre tokko gargaaruun miidhaa geessisaa san to'achuu danda'aniiru. Sababiin namichi kun miidhaa kana qaqqabsiiseef ammaaf hin beekamu.

title: Trump asks US Supreme Court to allow mail-in voting restrictions
english: President Trump has appealed to the Supreme Court to reinstate strict new limitations on mail-in voting that were previously blocked by a lower court. The contested executive order would involve federal agencies in managing voter lists and place tighter controls on how mail ballots are delivered. While the administration argues these measures are simply policy guidelines, a federal judge ruled that the president does not have the constitutional authority to unilaterally alter state-run election procedures.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ በታችኛው ፍርድ ቤት ታግደው የነበሩትን በፖስታ የሚደረጉ ድምፅ አሰጣጥ ላይ የተጣሉ አዳዲስ ገደቦችን እንዲያስፈጽሙ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱን ጠይቀዋል። ይህ የአስፈፃሚ ትዕዛዝ የፌደራል ኤጀንሲዎች የምርጫ ዝርዝሮችን እንዲያስተዳድሩ እና የፖስታ ድምፅ መስጫ ወረቀቶች በሚደርሱበት ሁኔታ ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እንዲያደርጉ የሚያስገድድ ነው። አስተዳደሩ እነዚህ እርምጃዎች የፖሊሲ መመሪያዎች ብቻ ናቸው ቢልም፣ አንድ የፌደራል ዳኛ ፕሬዚዳንቱ በክልል ደረጃ የሚደረጉ የምርጫ ሂደቶችን በራሳቸው የመቀየር ሕገ-መንግስታዊ ስልጣን እንደሌላቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp murtee mana murtii sadarkaa gadii kanaan dura dhoorkamee ture, kan daangaa sagalee poostaan kennamu irratti kaayame akka kaasuuf mana murtii olaanaa gaafataniiru. Ajajni kun qaamoleen federaalaa tarree namoota sagalee kennan akka bulchan fi akkaata sagaleen poostaan itti dhaqqabu irratti to'annoo cimaa akka godhan kan dirqisiisu dha. Mootummaan tarkaanfiin kun qajeelfama siyaasaa qofa dha jedhee falmuus, abbaan murtee tokko pireezidaantiin adeemsa filannoo kanneen naannoleen gaggeeffaman kophaa isaanii jijjiiruuf aangoo seera bu'uuraa akka hin qabne ibsaniiru.

title: UN slams Israel’s expansion of illegal settlements in occupied West Bank
english: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has strongly criticized Israel's decision to expand and legalize settlements in the occupied West Bank. He stated that these actions violate international law and represent a significant barrier to achieving a two-state peace agreement. This condemnation follows a recent rise in regional violence and displacements affecting both Palestinian and Israeli communities.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ዋና ጸሐፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ በእስራኤል የተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ እስራኤል ሰፈራዎችን ለማስፋፋት እና ህጋዊ ለማድረግ ያቀደችውን እቅድ አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች አለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥሱ እና በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ዘላቂ ሰላም እንዳይፈጠር ትልቅ እንቅፋት መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Antooniyoo Guterres, Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa (West Bank) keessatti manneen jireenyaa babal'isuufafi seeraan beekamtii kennuuf karoorfatte cimsee balaaleffateera. Tarkaanfiin kun seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsuufi furmaata biyya lamaa irra gahuuf gufuu guddaa ta'uu isaa ibseera. Balaaleffannaan kun kan dhufe, walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti dabalaa jiruufi miidhaa namoota irratti gahuu hordofuunidha.

title: Nvidia plans $250bn push to bolster OpenAI’s infrastructure ambitions
english: Nvidia is reportedly planning to provide a $250 billion funding guarantee to help OpenAI lease a massive new data center project in Ohio. This partnership aims to strengthen OpenAI’s independent infrastructure, as they currently rely on other tech giants for computing power. However, industry experts have expressed concerns about the financial risks and potential market instability caused by such massive investments in an unprofitable startup.
amharic: ኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) የኦፕን ኤአይ (OpenAI) ግዙፍ የመረጃ ማዕከል ግንባታን ለመደገፍ 250 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ዋስትና ለመስጠት እየተነጋገረ ነው። ይህ ስምምነት ኦፕን ኤአይ አሁን ካለበት በሌሎች ኩባንያዎች ላይ የመደገፍ ሁኔታ ወጥቶ የራሱን መሠረተ ልማት እንዲገነባ ያስችለዋል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ ትርፋማ ባልሆነ ድርጅት ላይ የሚደረገው ይህ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኢንቨስትመንት የገበያ መረጋጋትን ሊያውኩ እንደሚችል የዘርፉ ባለሙያዎች ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Nvidia, OpenAI dhaabbata Ohio keessatti buufata daataa gurguddaa ijaaruuf gargaaruuf qarshii biliyoona 250 akka isaanif gumaachu dubbatameera. Walii galteen kun OpenAI yeroo ammaa teeknolojii warra biroo irraa fayyadamaa jiru irraa bilisa bahee, buufata mataa isaa akka ijaarratuuf gargaara. Haata’u malee, ogeeyyonni gabaa akka jedhanitti, investimentiin akkanaa kun dhaabbata faayidaa hin argatinirratti taasifamuun isaa shakkiifi balaa diinagdee uumuu danda’a.

title: Hopes of return to diplomacy as US-Iran hold fire for third day
english: The United States and Iran have suspended military attacks for three consecutive days, raising cautious optimism for a potential return to diplomatic talks. Mediators from Qatar and Pakistan are working to facilitate dialogue, although both sides remain publicly divided on whether direct negotiations are actually occurring. While the pause offers a temporary relief, regional security remains uncertain due to ongoing drone activity and conflicting statements from both nations.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና ኢራን ለሶስት ተከታታይ ቀናት ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶችን በማቆማቸው ወደ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች ለመመለስ ያላቸው ተስፋ እየጨመረ መጥቷል። የኳታር እና የፓኪስታን አደራዳሪዎች ውይይቶችን ለማስጀመር እየሞከሩ ቢሆንም፣ ሁለቱ ወገኖች ቀጥተኛ ድርድር ስለመኖሩ የሚሰጡት አስተያየት ይለያያል። ምንም እንኳን የተኩስ ማቆሙ ጊዜያዊ እፎይታ ቢፈጥርም፣ በክልሉ ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ አሁንም አሳሳቢ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ameerikaan fi Iraan guyyoota sadan darban waraana dhaabuun isaanii, gara marii diippiloomasiitti deebi'uuf abdii uumee jira. Qindeesitootni biyyoota Qaataar fi Paakistaanii mariin akka jalqabuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiranis, gamtaaleen lamaanuu mariin kallattii gaggeeffamaa jiraachuu irratti walii hin galle. Waraanni yeroof dhaabbachuun isaa tasgabbii tokko fidee jiraatus, haalli nageenyaa naannichaa ammas rakkoo keessa jira.

title: Has Burnham kept his promise to do better on Israel’s war on Gaza?
english: British Prime Minister Burnham has recently formed his new cabinet, filling key positions in defense and foreign policy. This development has sparked questions regarding whether the government will shift its stance or influence concerning Israel's ongoing war in Gaza. Observers are currently analyzing these new appointments to determine if the administration will honor previous commitments to improve its handling of the conflict.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር በርንሃም አዲስ ካቢኔያቸውን በመመስረት በመከላከያ እና በውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር መስሪያ ቤቶች ላይ አዳዲስ ሹመቶችን ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ለውጥ ብሪታንያ በእስራኤል እና በጋዛ መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ላይ ያላትን አቋም ወይም ተፅእኖ ይለውጥ እንደሆነ ጥያቄ አስነስቷል። ተንታኞች አዲሱ አስተዳደር በግጭቱ ዙሪያ የገባውን ቃልኪዳን ይጠብቅ እንደሆነ እየተከታተሉ ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Biraayitanii Barnaam kaabineta isaa haaraa dhaabbatee, iddoo murteessoo ta'an kanneen akka ittisaa fi dhimma alaa ramadeera. Jijjiiramni kun Biraayitanin waraana Israa'el fi Gaaza gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru irratti qabdu ykn dhiibbaa geessistu jijjiiramuu ishee irratti shakkii uumera. Ogeeyyonni dhimma kana hordofan, mootummaan haaraan kun waadaa dura seene raawwachuuf tarkaanfii fudhatu ykn hin fudhatuu jedhanii xiinxalaa jiru.

title: Unreleased footage reveals Lindsey Graham’s push for war on Iran
english: Recently surfaced documentary footage shows the late US Senator Lindsey Graham expressing pride in his role advocating for a war against Iran. The clips reveal that the senator had been actively pushing for military intervention against the country for many years. He described the outcome of these actions as one of the most significant achievements of his career.
amharic: በቅርብ ጊዜ የወጡ የዶክመንተሪ ምስሎች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የሟቹ አሜሪካዊ ሴናተር ሊንዚ ግራሃም በኢራን ላይ ጦርነት እንዲከፈት ሲያደርጉት የነበረውን ጥረት በኩራት ይገልጻሉ። እነዚህ ምስሎች ሴናተሩ ለበርካታ ዓመታት በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ሲወተውቱ እንደነበር ያጋልጣሉ። ግራሃም ይህንን ተግባራቸውን በሕይወታቸው ከፈጸሟቸው ትልቅ ስኬቶች አንዱ እንደሆነ ሲናገሩ ተደምጠዋል።
oromo: Suuroota fi viidiyoowwan dokumantarii dhiheenya kana baʼaniin, senaterri Amerikaa kan durii Lindsey Graham waraana Iran irratti banamee ture deggeruun isaanii fi itti gammaduun isaanii ifa taʼeera. Viidiyoowwan kunneen senaterichi waggoota hedduuf Iran irratti tarkaanfiin waraanaa akka fudhatamu dhiibbaa godhaa akka turan ibsu. Graham gocha kana hojii jireenya isaanii keessatti raawwatan keessaa isa guddaa fi injifannoo guddaa akka taʼe dubbataniiru.

title: Spain protests mass ‘touristification’ of Mallorca
english: Thousands of residents recently marched in Palma, Mallorca, to protest against the negative effects of excessive tourism in Spain. Locals argue that the record-breaking number of visitors is damaging the natural environment and making daily life difficult for the community. With Spain anticipating 100 million tourists this year, protesters are calling for changes to address the strain caused by this mass tourism.
amharic: በስፔን ማሎርካ ደሴት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ከመጠን በላይ በሆነ የቱሪዝም እንቅስቃሴ መማረራቸውን በመግለጽ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንደሚሉት፣ ቁጥሩ ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየጨመረ የመጣው ጎብኚዎች የተፈጥሮ አካባቢያቸውን እየጎዱና የኑሮ ሁኔታቸውን እያቃወሱ ይገኛሉ። ስፔን ዘንድሮ 100 ሚሊዮን ቱሪስቶችን እንደምትቀበል እየጠበቀች ባለችበት ወቅት፣ ተቃዋሚዎች በዘርፉ ላይ ለውጥ እንዲደረግ እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Paalmaatti, jiraattonni kumaan lakkaa'aman turizmii baay'ee ta'e mormuudhaan hiriira bahaniiru. Jiraattonni akka jedhanitti, tuuristoonni biyyattii keessatti baay'achuun isaanii naannoo fi jireenya isaanii irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisaa jira. Ispeen waggaa kana keessa tuuristoota miiliyoona 100 ol ni simatti jedhamee kan eegamu yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu dhiibbaa kana hir'isuuf mootummaan tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: UN eyeing potential Israeli war crimes in Lebanon
english: UN Human Rights Chief Volker Turk has accused Israel of committing major human rights violations and potential war crimes during its ongoing military operations in Lebanon. During a recent visit, he expressed alarm at the widespread destruction of villages and the extreme suffering of displaced civilians despite an earlier ceasefire agreement. Turk emphasized that international law must be upheld without exception and called for urgent accountability for those responsible for these actions.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነር ቮልከር ቱርክ፣ እስራኤል በሊባኖስ እያካሄደች ባለው ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ከፍተኛ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን እና የጦር ወንጀል ሊፈረጁ የሚችሉ ድርጊቶችን እየፈጸመች ነው ሲሉ ከሰሱ። ቱርክ በቅርቡ በሊባኖስ ያደረጉትን ጉብኝት ተከትሎ፣ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም መንደሮች እየወደሙ እና ሲቪሎች ከፍተኛ መከራ እያዩ መሆኑ እንዳሳሰባቸው ገልጸዋል። ማንኛውም አካል ከአለም አቀፍ ህግ በላይ ሊሆን እንደማይችል ያሳሰቡት ኮሚሽነሩ፣ ለተፈጸሙት ጥሰቶች ተጠያቂነት ሊኖር እንደሚገባ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan mirga namoomaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii Volker Turk, Israa'el duula waraanaa Libaanos keessatti gaggeessaa jirtuun mirga namoomaa cabsuu fi yakka waraanaa raawwachuu dandeessi jedhee himate. Turk daawwannaa inni Libaanos gooteen booda, waliigaltee gadi dhiisuu waraanaa duraan godhamee ture iyyuu osoo jiruu, gandaa fi manneen hedduun barbada'anii fi namoonni hedduun buqqa'anii rakkoo cimaa keessa jiraachuu isaanii ibse. Seerri idil-addunyaa namoota hundarratti akka hojjetuu fi yakka raawwatameefis itti gaafatamummaan akka jiraatu cimsanii hubachiise.

title: Yemen's FM says Houthis using Bab al-Mandeb to mirror Iran's pressure
english: Yemen's Foreign Minister Designate, Afrah al-Zouba, has accused Houthi rebels of attempting to dominate global shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. She argues that the group is copying Iran's tactics in the Strait of Hormuz to exert regional pressure. According to al-Zouba, the lack of a strong international response to recent maritime attacks has encouraged the Houthis to continue their aggressive behavior.
amharic: የየመን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ተሿሚ አፍራህ አል-ዙባ፣ የሁቲ አማፂያን በባብ ኤል-መንደብ የባህር መተላለፊያ ላይ ዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ መርከቦችን ለመቆጣጠር እየሞከሩ እንደሆነ ገለጹ። ቡድኑ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ስርጥ ኢራን የምትጠቀመውን ተመሳሳይ ስልት በመከተል ጫና ለመፍጠር እንደሚጥር ተናግረዋል። አል-ዙባ እንዳሉት፣ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ በባህር ላይ ለሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች የሰጠው ምላሽ አጥጋቢ አለመሆኑ ሁቲዎች ድፍረት እንዲሰማቸው አድርጓቸዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Yaman Afrah al-Zouba, finxaaleyyin Huutii karaa galaana Bab el-Mandeb to'achuuf yaalii gochaa jiru jedhan. Gareen kun dhiibbaa uumuuf akka mala Iraan galaana Hormuz irratti fayyadamtu hordofaa akka jiru himameera. Al-Zouba akka jedhanitti, miidhaa dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti raawwatamaa jiruuf deebiin idil-addunyaa cimaa waan hin taaneef, gochi kun akka itti fufu jajjabeessera.

title: Palestinian woman delivers stillborn baby after Israeli checkpoint delay, medics say
english: A pregnant Palestinian woman suffered a tragic loss after Israeli soldiers delayed her ambulance for over 30 minutes at a West Bank checkpoint. Due to the wait and forced shutdown of the vehicle, the woman had to deliver her stillborn baby while still inside the ambulance. Although the mother survived and reached the hospital in stable condition, medical workers highlighted that the military's obstruction prevented timely life-saving care.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ መቆጣጠሪያ ጣቢያ እስራኤላዊያን ወታደሮች አምቡላንስን ለግማሽ ሰዓት ያህል በማዘግየታቸው አንዲት ነፍሰ ጡር ፍልስጤማዊት ሴት ልጅዋን በሞት አጥታለች። በአምቡላንሱ ውስጥ የነበሩ የሕክምና ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ወታደሮቹ አምቡላንሱን እንዲያጠፉ በማስገደዳቸው ምክንያት ሴትዮዋ በድንገተኛ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ሳለች ፅንሷ በአምቡላንሱ ውስጥ በሞት ተወልዷል። እናትየዋ በሕይወት ብትተርፍም፣ የሕክምና ባለሙያዎች ይህ መዘግየት ለሕይወት አድን ሥራው እንቅፋት እንደፈጠረ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dubartii ulfa kan taate fiisxiniimtuun tokko, loltootni Israa'el daandii cufan irratti ambulaansii ishee daqiiqaa 30 ol waan turcaniif mucaa ishee garaa keessatti du'e deesseetti. Hojjettoonni fayyaa akka jedhanitti, loltootni ambulaansichi akka dhaabbatu waan dirqisiisaniif, dubartittiin haala hamaa keessa utuu jirtuu mucaa ishee du'e deessuun dirqamteetti. Haati ishee haala tasgabbaa'aa keessa kan jirtu ta'us, ogeeyyiin fayyaa tursiisuun kun tajaajila hatattamaa fayyaa gufachiisuu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: US Senator Graham offered military support for Israeli war on Lebanon, new footage shows
english: Newly released documentary footage shows US Senator Lindsey Graham expressing support for military conflicts in Iran and Lebanon. In one recorded conversation, Graham unilaterally offered Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu direct US military assistance for the campaign in Lebanon. These clips were captured by filmmaker Alex Holder, who had extensive access to Graham's private meetings and discussions with world leaders.
amharic: በቅርብ ጊዜ ይፋ የሆነ የዶክመንተሪ ምስል ሴናተር ሊንዚ ግርሃም በአይራን እና በሊባኖስ ላይ ለተጀመረው ጦርነት ድጋፋቸውን ሲገልጹ ያሳያል። በምስሉ ላይ ግርሃም በቀጥታ ለእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በሊባኖስ ለሚካሄደው ጦርነት የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ለማቅረብ ሲሞክሩ ይታያሉ። ይህ መረጃ የተገኘው የፊልም ባለሙያው አሌክስ ሆልደር በሴናተሩ የግል ስብሰባዎች ላይ በነበረው ቆይታ የተቀረጹ ምስሎችን ይፋ በማድረጉ ነው።
oromo: Suurri fi viidiyoon gara fuulduraatti bahe akka ibsuutti, Seneteri Lindsey Graham waraana Iran fi Lebanon irratti geggeeffamuuf deggarsa qaban ibsanii jiru. Viidiyoo kana keessatti, Seneterichi ministira muummee Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu waliin mari'achaa, waraana Lebanon irratti geggeeffamuuf deggarsa waraanaa Amerikaa dhiyeessuuf ofiin of kaadhimanii turan. Ragaaleen kun kan qophaa'an ogeessa filmii Alex Holder ta'ee, inni kunis walgahii dhuunfaa Seneterichaa fi hoggantoota biyyoota biraa irratti hirmaachuun viidiyoo kana waraabe.

title: Israeli election campaign billboards in Cyprus spark debate
english: Israeli politician Gadi Eisenkot is facing criticism for placing political campaign billboards in Cyprus that target Israeli tourists traveling through Larnaca airport. Local official Fidias Panayiotou condemned the move, arguing that using foreign territory for domestic political campaigning violates national sovereignty. While many Israelis visit the island for vacations, officials insist that the country should not be used as a platform for Israeli electioneering.

oromo: Hogganaan mormituu Israa'el Gaadii Aayizenkoot biyya Qophuroositti beeksisa duula filannoo Israa'elitti xiyyeeffatu gaggeessuun isaa komii guddaa kaasera. Miseensi Paarlaamaa Qophuroos Fidiyaas Paanaayootuu, duulli kun bilisummaa fi aangoo biyyattii kan sarbu ta'uu ibsuun mormiisaa ibseera. Israa'elonni yeroo boqonnaa isaanii Qophuroositti dabarsuu kan jaallatan ta'us, aanga'oonni biyyattii lafti isaanii duula filannoo biyya biraatiif ooluu akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru.

title: UN experts urge Iran to halt death sentences of 10 men
english: A group of United Nations experts is demanding that Iran stop the execution of ten young men who were sentenced following anti-government demonstrations. The officials criticized the legal process, noting that the closed trials lacked transparency and failed to meet international fair trial requirements. This plea follows the earlier execution of two other young men who were part of the same group of twelve defendants.

title: Wildfire now nine miles away from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
english: A massive wildfire in France’s Gironde region has reached within nine miles of Bordeaux, prompting city officials to prepare for potential mass evacuations. Firefighters are struggling to contain the blaze, which has already destroyed over 40,000 hectares and hundreds of homes. Authorities warn that this is an unprecedented fire season, with many incidents linked to human carelessness or intentional arson.

title: Why have US-Lebanon direct flights been banned for 40 years?
english: Direct flights between the United States and Lebanon have been prohibited for forty years following the hijacking of TWA Flight 847 in the 1980s. This long-standing security restriction was recently addressed by Donald Trump, who indicated that these aviation connections could now be re-established. The ban had remained in place for decades as a significant safety measure after the initial incident.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በሊባኖስ መካከል የነበረው ቀጥታ የበረራ አገልግሎት በ1980ዎቹ የTWA በረራ 847 ታግቶ በመወሰዱ ምክንያት ለአርባ ዓመታት ታግዶ ቆይቷል። ይህ ለረጅም ዓመታት የቆየ የደህንነት እገዳ በቅርቡ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ትኩረት የተደረገበት ሲሆን፣ የበረራ ግንኙነቶቹ እንደገና ሊቀጥሉ እንደሚችሉ ተገልጿል። እገዳው ከተፈጠረው አደጋ በኋላ እንደ ዋና የደህንነት ጥንቃቄ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ተግባራዊ ሆኖ ቆይቷል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri kallattiin Ameerikaa fi Libaanoon gidduutti taasifamu, erga xiyyaarri TWA 847 bara 1980ota keessa butamee booda waggoota afurtamaaf dhorkamee ture. Dhorkaan nageenyaa yeroo dheeraaf ture kun dhiheenya kana Donald Trumpin kaasamee, hariiroon balalii kun ammas itti fufuu akka danda'u ibsameera. Dhorkaan kun erga balaan sun mudatee booda tarkaanfii nageenyaa cimaa ta'ee waggoota dheeraaf hojiirra ture.

title: Pakistan-administered Kashmir opens polls in violence-wracked vote
english: Pakistan-administered Kashmir has begun the first of three rounds of local legislative elections amid a period of intense instability and violence. Dozens of people have died in recent weeks during protests, prompting authorities to implement strict security measures and internet blackouts. These disruptions have made campaigning difficult for candidates and have raised concerns about the overall impact on the electoral process.

title: Are the US and Iran heading towards a forever war?
english: Tensions between the United States and Iran have escalated following nearly two weeks of American airstrikes targeting Iranian civilian infrastructure. Iran has retaliated by attacking the critical facilities of US allies in the Gulf region. President Trump has signaled a potential increase in these attacks, fueling concerns that the two nations are spiraling into a long-term, large-scale military conflict.

title: Lebanon’s displaced endure ‘exhaustion and despair’
english: The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Volker Turk, has highlighted the severe suffering of Lebanese families displaced by ongoing Israeli military strikes. These individuals have been forced to relocate repeatedly, leading to widespread mental trauma and physical fatigue. Turk is calling for a lasting ceasefire to ensure these families can finally return to their homes in safety.

title: Saudi Arabia defends against drone strikes from ‘Iran-backed’ groups
english: Saudi Arabia successfully intercepted drone attacks targeting its oil infrastructure, attributing the strikes to Iran-supported factions in Iraq. Similar drone incidents were also reported in Jordan and northern Iraq, raising concerns that militant groups may be testing the current fragile pause in hostilities between the United States and Iran. While the Iraqi government has pledged to investigate the origins of the strikes, these events highlight ongoing instability and regional security challenges.

title: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars
english: Ukraine has rejected Iranian threats following a drone strike on a cargo ship in the Caspian Sea that Kyiv claims was transporting military supplies to Russia. Ukrainian officials argue that Tehran is an active partner in Russia's war effort by providing weaponry, including drones and missiles. This operation marks a significant escalation by linking the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran through the disruption of a key Russian-Iranian supply route.

title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
english: Police in Toronto are investigating after shots were fired at the US consulate building for the second time this year. A witness observed a white car speeding away from the scene early Monday morning, but authorities chose not to pursue it further due to public safety risks. No one was harmed during the incident, and officials are currently working with national and international partners to identify the suspects.
amharic: የቶሮንቶ ፖሊስ በዚህ ዓመት ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ በአሜሪካ ቆንስላ ህንጻ ላይ የተኩስ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን ተከትሎ ምርመራ እያደረገ ነው። ሰኞ ማለዳ ላይ አንድ ነጭ መኪና ከቦታው በፍጥነት ሲሸሽ ቢታይም፣ የጸጥታ ስጋትን በመፍራት ፖሊስ ማሳደዱን አቁሟል። በዚህ ጥቃት ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሰው የለም፤ ባለስልጣናትም ወንጀለኞችን ለመያዝ ከአገር ውስጥ እና ከዓለም አቀፍ አካላት ጋር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።

Miidhaan qaamaa namarra ga'e hin jiru, qaamoleen mootummaas shakkamtoota to'annoo jala oolchuuf gargaarsa qaamolee biyya keessaa fi idil-addunyaa waliin hojjechaa jiru.

title: New UK PM Burnham assures Zelenskyy of continuing Ukraine support
english: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham met with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to reaffirm Britain's absolute commitment to supporting Ukraine against the ongoing Russian invasion. During their visit to a naval training base, Burnham announced that the UK will provide Ukraine with advanced technology to help counter Russian drones. Zelenskyy traveled to the UK ahead of his upcoming meetings in Washington, as he seeks to strengthen international efforts to secure a peaceful resolution to the war.

oromo: Muummee ministiraa UK haaraa Andy Burnham fi pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodymyr Zelenskyy wal arguun, UK Yukreen weerara Raashiyaa ittisuu irratti gargaarsa guutuu gochuuf waadaa galte jirti. Daawwannaa buufata leenjii galaanaa irratti, muummeen ministirichaa UK teeknooloojii ammayyaa xiyyaara maleeyyii Raashiyaa ittisuuf gargaaru Yukreeniif akka kennitu beeksisaniiru. Zelenskyy marii Waashingtonitti godhamuun dura, walitti bu'iinsa kana nagaadhaan xumuruuf deeggarsa idil-addunyaa cimsuuf gara UK kan deeman.

title: Will UNESCO’s heritage listing halt Israeli plans for West Bank’s Sebastia?
english: UNESCO has officially designated the ancient site of Sebastia in the West Bank as a World Heritage site in danger to help protect it from Israeli expansion. Palestinian officials hope this international recognition will prevent Israel from seizing the land and moving forward with settlement projects that threaten both the historic ruins and local tourism. Israel has criticized the move as politically motivated, while residents fear that proposed laws could permanently strip them of their authority over this significant archaeological landmark.
amharic: ዩኔስኮ በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኘውን የሴባስቲያ ጥንታዊ ቅርርስፍራ ከእስራኤል መስፋፋት ለመከላከል እንዲረዳ በዓለም ቅርስነት እና በአደጋ ላይ እንዳለ ቅርስነት መዝግቦታል። የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ይህ ውሳኔ እስራኤል መሬቱን ከመውረስ እና ቅርስነቱን አደጋ ላይ ከሚጥሉ የግንባታ ፕሮጀክቶች እንድትቆጠብ ያደርጋል ብለው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ። እስራኤል ውሳኔውን ፖለቲካዊ ነው ስትል ትቃወመዋለች፤ የሀገር ውስጥ ነዋሪዎች ግን አዲሱ የእስራኤል ህግ በቅርስ ስፍራው ላይ ያላቸውን አስተዳደራዊ ስልጣን ሊነጥቃቸው እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: UNESCO’n lafa durii Sebastiyaa kan naannoo Lixaa (West Bank) jiru, babal'ina Israa'el irraa eeguuf jecha akka lafa dhaala addunyaa fi lafa balaa keessa jiruutti galmeesseera. title: What drove Venezuela’s decision to leave the ICC?
english: Venezuela has formally initiated its withdrawal from the International Criminal Court, with officials citing a perceived bias against nations in the Global South. While the country's leadership describes this move as irreversible, the ICC stated that ongoing investigations into alleged crimes against humanity will proceed unaffected. Experts note that this decision reflects a shifting foreign policy in Caracas, though legal provisions ensure the court maintains its jurisdiction over current cases for at least one year.
amharic: ቬኔዙዌላ በአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ላይ ያላት አድልዎ አለ የሚል ክስ በማቅረብ ከፍርድ ቤቱ በይፋ እንደምትወጣ አስታውቃለች። የሀገሪቱ መንግስት ይህንን ውሳኔ የማይቀለበስ ሲል ቢገልጸውም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን በሀገሪቱ ላይ የተጀመሩ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ምርመራዎች በውሳኔው እንደማይገቱ ገልጿል። በህጉ መሰረት የሀገር መልቀቅ ውሳኔ ተግባራዊ የሚሆነው ከአንድ አመት በኋላ በመሆኑ፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ በወቅቱ እየተካሄዱ ባሉ ጉዳዮች ላይ ስልጣኑን እንደያዘ ይቆያል።
oromo: Venezuuelaan murtii mana murtii yakka addunyaa (ICC) irratti, biyyoota giddu-galeessa fi kibbaa addunyaa irratti loogii raawwata jechuun mana murtichaa gadhiisuuf murteessiteetti. Mootummaan biyyattii murtin kun kan hin jijjiiramne akka ta'e ibsus, mana murtichi garuu qorannoon yakka suukanneessaa irratti eegale akka itti fufu beeksisera. Seerichaan, biyyi tokko mana murtichaa gadi dhiisuuf yeroo waggaa tokko kan fudhatu waan ta'eef, mana murtichi qorannoo isaa itti fufuuf aangoo guutuu qaba.

title: India suspends police officer for firing AK-47 at student protesters
english: An Indian police officer has been suspended following the use of an AK-47 against students who were demonstrating against exam paper leaks. The protests have caused significant political fallout, including the resignation of the country's education minister. Authorities are now facing public criticism for employing excessive force against the student protesters.
amharic: በህንድ ፈተናዎች መለቀቃቸውን በመቃወም ላይ በነበሩ ተማሪዎች ላይ የAK-47 ጥይት የተኮሰው የፖሊስ አባል ከስራ ታግዷል። የተማሪዎቹ ተቃውሞ የሀገሪቱ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር እንዲለቁ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናቱ በተቃዋሚዎች ላይ የሃይል እርምጃ በመውሰዳቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበባቸው ይገኛል።

Mormii kana hordofee ministeerri barnootaa biyyattii aangoo gadi liiqeera. Mootummaan barattoota irratti humni garmalee fayyadame jechuun qaamoleen mirga namoomaa fi hawaasni mormii guddaa kaasaniiru.

title: Chad to join raft of withdrawals from International Criminal Court
english: Chad has officially initiated the process to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, becoming the fifth nation to do so recently. The military government cited concerns over the court's perceived bias toward African nations and its overall lack of effectiveness. This move follows significant diplomatic pressure from the United States, which has actively campaigned against the tribunal's operations.
amharic: ቻድ ዓለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤትን (ICC) ለቃ ለመውጣት ሂደቱን መጀመሯን ይፋ አድርጋለች፤ ይህም በቅርቡ ፍርድ ቤቱን የለቀቀች አምስተኛዋ ሀገር አድርጓታል። የሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ መንግስት ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰደው ፍርድ ቤቱ በአፍሪካ ሀገራት ላይ አድልዎ ያደርጋል በሚል ቅሬታ እና በውጤታማነት ላይ ባለው ክፍተት ምክንያት ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው አሜሪካ በዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤቱ ላይ ባሳደረችው ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ተጽዕኖ መሆኑ ተነግሯል።

title: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
english: Severe wildfires are ravaging France and Spain following record-breaking summer heatwaves, leading to the displacement of over 300,000 residents. The fires have destroyed massive areas of land and triggered rare fire-generated thunderstorms, which complicate firefighting efforts by potentially sparking new blazes. Authorities are currently deploying specialized aircraft to drop water and fire retardant in a desperate attempt to contain the flames.
amharic: በአውሮፓ እየተከሰተ ያለው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት በፈረንሳይ እና በስፔን አስከፊ የደን ቃጠሎ አስከትሎ ከ300,000 በላይ ሰዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጓል። ቃጠሎው በራሱ የሚፈጥራቸውን መብረቅ እና አውሎ ንፋስ ጨምሮ አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታዎችን በመፍጠሩ ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱን ለማጥፋት ልዩ አውሮፕላኖችን በመጠቀም ውሃ እና የእሳት መከላከያ ኬሚካሎችን በመርጨት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ho'i daangaa darbe Awurooppaa keessatti muudate biyyoota Faransaayii fi Ispeen keessatti ibidda bosonaa hamaa kaasee, namoonni 300,000 ol ta'an manaa isaanii akka godaanaan dirqisiiseera. Ibidni kun haala qilleensa hamaa fi ofii isaatii obomboleettii uumuun akka babal'atu waan ta'eef, to'achuun isaa ulfaataa ta'eera. Aangeyyoonni ibidda kana dhaamsuuf xiyyaara adda fayyadamuun bishaan fi qoricha ibidda dhaamsu roobsuun tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: Chile captures fugitive convicted of singer Victor Jara's murder under Pinochet
english: Chilean authorities have apprehended Nelson Haase, a former military officer who had been on the run after receiving a 25-year prison sentence for his role in the 1973 murder and kidnapping of folk singer Victor Jara. Jara was a famous activist killed by the Pinochet regime shortly after the military coup. Haase, who disappeared when his final sentence was confirmed in 2023, was finally located by police in the southern part of the country.
amharic: የቺሊ ፖሊስ እ.ኤ.አ. በ1973 በፒኖቼ አገዛዝ ወቅት የታዋቂውን ድምፃዊ ቪክቶር ጃራን ግድያ እና ታፍኖ መወሰድ ተካፋይ በመሆን የ25 ዓመት እስራት የተፈረደበትን ኔልሰን ሃሴን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ሃሴ የፍርድ ውሳኔው ሲተላለፍ ከፍትህ አካላት ተሰውሮ የቆየ ሲሆን፣ ባለፈው ቅዳሜ በሀገሪቱ ደቡባዊ ክፍል ተገኝቷል። ቪክቶር ጃራ በወቅቱ በነበረው ወታደራዊ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ከተገደሉ በርካታ ሰዎች መካከል አንዱ ሲሆን፣ ግድያው የአገዛዙን ጭካኔ ከሚያሳዩ ዋና ዋና ክስተቶች አንዱ ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Poolisiin biyya Chiilii, ajjeechaa fi butii sirba-gaa fi waltajii wallee Victor Jara bara 1973tti raawwatamee ture irratti hirmaachuun waggaa 25 hidhaatti murteeffamee ture Nelson Haase to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Haase murtiin hidhaa kun erga ragga'ee booda bilxigoo ta'ee badee ture; garuu guyyaa Dilbataa kutaa kibba biyyattii keessatti argameera. Victor Jara sirreessaa fi qabsoo siyaasaa kan ture yoo ta'u, ajjeechaan isaa mootummaa diktaatoraa Piinoochee jalatti namoota hedduu irratti miidhaa gurguddaa qaqqabeef fakkeenya guddaa ta'eera.

title: Israeli raid sparks fire at UN Palestinian refugee centre
english: Israeli forces conducted a raid on a United Nations facility for Palestinian refugees located in East Jerusalem. During the operation, authorities used tear gas and stun grenades, leading to the detention of staff members and the outbreak of a fire. This incident occurred shortly after Israel announced its intention to tear down the building.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም በሚገኝ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ማሰልጠኛ ማዕከል ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል። ወታደሮቹ ባደረጉት እንቅስቃሴ አስለቃሽ ጭስ እና የድምጽ ቦምቦችን በመጠቀማቸው የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል፣ በተጨማሪም የድርጅቱ ሰራተኞች ታስረዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው እስራኤል ህንጻውን ለማፍረስ እቅድ እንዳላት ካስታወቀች በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el iddoo leenjii gargaarsa baqattoota Filisxeem kan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii (UN) magaala Yerusaalem bahaa keessatti argamu haleelanii jiru. Hojiin kun gaazii imimmaansisuu fi boba'aa sagalee cimaa uumu fayyadamuudhaan kan gaggeeffame yoo ta'u, hojjettootni qabamanii ibiddi ka'uun isaas gabaafameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, Israa'el bakka sana diiguuf karoorfachuu ishee erga beeksistee boodadha.

title: Mapping Israeli settler violence in the West Bank
english: Israeli settlers have intensified their violent activities in the West Bank, recently setting fire to two mosques and leaving racist graffiti. UN data highlights a significant increase in such attacks, with thousands of incidents reported since early 2025. These tensions reached a deadly point in the village of Tal, where clashes between residents and settlers resulted in several deaths.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚኖሩ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች የሁለት መስጊዶችን በእሳት በማቃጠል እና ዘረኛ ጽሁፎችን በመጻፍ ጥቃታቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው ከ2025 መጀመሪያ አንስቶ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል። በታል መንደር በተፈጠረ ግጭትም በነዋሪዎችና በሰፋሪዎች መካከል በተደረገው ፍጥጫ የበርካታ ሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል።
oromo: Qubattoonni Israa'el naannoo Daangaa Dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti masjidota lama gubuufi barreeffamoota jibbaa barreessuun haleellaa isaanii daran hammaachiisaniiru. Odeeffannoon Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka agarsiisutti, jalqaba bara 2025 irraa eegalee haleellaan akkasii kumaan lakkaa'amu raawwatameera. Gandoota naannoo sanaatti uummataafi qubattoota gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumameen lubbuun namoota hedduu darbeera.

title: How Israel uses settler-soldier terror to colonise the West Bank
english: The article argues that recent violence in the West Bank is not a series of isolated incidents, but a coordinated strategy of colonization. Israeli forces and settlers work in tandem to systematically displace Palestinians, weaken local infrastructure, and seize territory. Officials frame these aggressive actions as security measures, yet they represent a calculated effort to expand settlements and redefine the land.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በዌስት ባንክ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት ተያያዥነት የሌላቸው ክስተቶች ሳይሆኑ፣ የተቀነባበረ የቅኝ ግዛት ስትራቴጂ መሆኑን ይገልጻል። የእስራኤል ጦር እና ሰፋሪዎች በመተባበር ፍልስጤማውያንን ከመሬታቸው ለማፈናቀል፣ መሰረተ ልማቶችን ለማዳከም እና መሬትን ለመውሰድ እየሰሩ ነው። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን ጥቃቶች እንደ የጸጥታ እርምጃ ቢገልጹዋቸውም፣ በእውነቱ ግን የሰፈራ መስፋፋትን የሚያፋጥን ስሌት የተሞላበት አካሄድ ነው።
oromo: Barruun kun walitti bu'iinsa naannoo West Bank keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun gocha tasaa osoo hin taane, tarsiimoo koloniyeeshinii qindaa'aa ta'uu ibsa. Waraanni Israa'el fi qubattoonni biyyattii giddutti walta'uun, lammiilee Falasxiin lafa isaanii irraa buqqisuuf, bu'uuraalee misoomaa diiguuf fi lafa to'achuuf hojjechaa jiru. Mootummaan gocha kana akka tarkaanfii nageenyaatti yoo dhiyeessus, kun garuu babal'ina qubannaa fi lafa fudhachuuf malaan kan raawwatamu dha.

title: Why Venezuela is leaving the ICC
english: Venezuela has announced its decision to withdraw from the International Criminal Court. The government claims the institution is biased against developing nations in the Global South. This development occurs while the court is already dealing with significant political challenges and internal leadership instability.
amharic: ቬኔዙኤላ ከአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ለመውጣት መወሰኗን አስታውቃለች። መንግስት ፍርድ ቤቱ በማደግ ላይ ባሉ ሀገራት ላይ ወገንተኝነት የተሞላበት አድልዎ እያደረገ ነው በማለት ይከሳል። ይህ ውሳኔ ፍርድ ቤቱ ውስብስብ የፖለቲካ ጫናዎች እና የአመራር ችግሮች በተጋረጡበት ወቅት የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Veenzuweellan mana murtiijajjaboo idil-addunyaa irraa gadi ba'uuf murteessiteetti. Mootummaan biyyattii mana murtichaa biyyoota guddachaa jiran irratti loogii raawwata jechuun himata. Murteen kun yeroo mana murtichi dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi rakkoolee hogganummaa keessa jiru kan dhufe dha.

title: Why a new war in Yemen could be different for the Houthis
english: Tensions in Yemen are escalating as Houthi forces transition from mobilization to active combat, including attacks on Saudi ships and renewed clashes with government-aligned groups. Although the Houthis have maintained control over northern Yemen for years, the strategic landscape has shifted due to the increased unity of anti-Houthi forces. A full-scale return to war may prove more difficult for the group this time compared to their initial rise to power in 2014.
amharic: በየመን የሁቲ ኃይሎች ወደ መጠነ ሰፊ ውጊያ እየተሸጋገሩ በመሆናቸው በአካባቢው ያለው ግጭት ተባብሷል። ምንም እንኳን ሁቲዎች ለዓመታት ሰሜናዊ የመንን በቁጥጥራቸው ስር ቢያቆዩም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የሁቲ ተቃዋሚ ኃይሎች በይበልጥ እየተጠናከሩ በመምጣታቸው ሁኔታው ለእነሱ አስቸጋሪ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል። ይህ አዲስ የጦርነት ስጋት በ2014 ከነበረው ሁኔታ በተለየ መልኩ ለቡድኑ ፈታኝ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Yemen keessatti humnoonni Huutii gara waraana bal'aatti ce'aa waan jiraniif walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa hamateera. Huutoonni waggoota hedduuf kaaba Yemen to'achaa turus, yeroo ammaa kanatti humnoonni Huutii mormaan tokkummaan jabachaa waan jiraniif haalli isaan quunnamu duraan caalaa ulfaataa ta'uu danda'a. Guddinni waraana kanaa kan bara 2014 wajjin wal bira qabamee yoo ilaalamu, garee kanaaf akka duraa salphaa akka hin taane beektonni ni ibsu.

title: Tigray’s Youth are Breaking the TPLF’s Narrative Monopoly
english: For decades, the TPLF maintained strict control over Tigray’s political narrative by suppressing independent media and using state-run outlets to spread propaganda. However, the emergence of social media and the activism of young people are now breaking this monopoly, allowing for more diverse political views and open criticism of the party. As the TPLF’s influence declines and its digital strategies falter, it is struggling to maintain authority in an increasingly challenging environment.
amharic: ለበርካታ አሥርተ ዓመታት ሕወሓት ነፃ ሚዲያን በማፈን እና የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙኃንን በመቆጣጠር የክልሉን የፖለቲካ ትረካ በብቸኝነት ሲቆጣጠር ቆይቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ግን የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መስፋፋት እና የወጣቶች ተሳትፎ ይህንን የቁጥጥር ሥርዓት እየተፈታተኑት ይገኛሉ። የሕወሓት የዲጂታል ፕሮፓጋንዳ አቅም እየተዳከመ በመምጣቱ እና አማራጭ የፖለቲካ ሃሳቦች በመፍለቃቸው፣ ፓርቲው በክልሉ ላይ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ ለማስቀጠል ከፍተኛ ትግል እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: waggoota dheeraaf, TPLF miidiyaa bilisaa ukkaamsuud fi miidiyaalee mootummaa to'achuudhaan yaada siyaasaa Tigraay guutummaatti to'achaa ture. Amma garuu, babal'achuu miidiyaalee hawaasaa fi qooda fudhannaa dargaggootaan to'annaan kun cabaa jira. Dhiibbaan dijitaalaa kan TPLF dadhabaa dhufuudhaan, yaada siyaasaa garaa garaa fi mormiin ifatti ba'uu danda'eera; kunis taayitaa TPLF irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira.

title: Anger, shock and grief - questions remain in the wake of the Berlin Pride attack
english: A violent attack during Berlin Pride resulted in the death of a woman and left dozens injured. The perpetrator, a 21-year-old known to authorities for radical ties and previous crimes, was killed by police shortly after the event. Government officials and the public are now questioning why the suspect had been released on a suspended sentence instead of remaining in prison despite his history of extremist behavior.

title: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February
english: Since February, over 600 American soldiers have been wounded in the ongoing conflict with Iran. The Pentagon is facing backlash for confusing and opaque casualty reporting, including the sudden reclassification of deceased personnel between different operational categories. Officials have dismissed these statistical inconsistencies as temporary technical issues, though critics argue the administration is failing to provide transparent information about the war.

title: Australian court rejects racial discrimination appeal by Pauline Hanson
english: An Australian federal court has dismissed an appeal by politician Pauline Hanson, confirming a previous ruling that she engaged in racial discrimination against Senator Mehreen Faruqi. The legal dispute centered on a 2022 social media post where Hanson told the Muslim senator to return to Pakistan. The judges ruled that the comments were unlawful, rejecting Hanson’s claims that they were protected under free speech, and emphasized that hate speech does not fall under such legal safeguards.

title: Israel’s approval of limited Gaza force a calculated manoeuvre, experts say
english: Israel has approved a small-scale pilot project to allow a limited foreign security force into a specific area of Gaza as part of a U.S.-backed peace proposal. Analysts believe this move is a strategic maneuver by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to reduce American diplomatic pressure before his visit to Washington. Experts warn that the initiative is unlikely to lead to lasting peace and may instead serve to further divide the Gaza Strip under strict Israeli control.

english: Indonesian authorities have officially prohibited two Dutch citizens from entering the country again due to their involvement in a controversial running club in Bali. title: Three killed in suspected shootout in US city of Seattle, police say
english: A violent shootout at the Bite of Seattle food festival has left three people dead and four others injured, including a young child. Local officials expressed deep concern regarding the increasing trend of gun violence in the city following this tragedy.

title: Houthis launch drone attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure
english: The Houthi group, backed by Iran, claimed responsibility for a drone strike targeting Saudi Arabian oil infrastructure on Monday. While the Houthis stated they successfully hit sensitive supply facilities, Saudi authorities have not yet confirmed any damage or injuries. Meanwhile, the Saudi government reported intercepting separate drone attacks originating from Iraq and has urged Iraqi officials to stop such hostile activities.

title: Israeli raids, demolitions continue across occupied West Bank
english: Israeli forces have intensified military operations across the West Bank, including a raid on a UN facility for Palestinian refugees in Qalandiya. During these incursions, troops used tear gas and stun grenades, leading to the detention of staff members and local residents. Similar raids and property demolitions were reported in multiple cities, including Nablus, Jenin, and Ramallah.

title: Karim Khan dared to hold Israel to account - and that's why he was brought down
english: International Criminal Court Prosecutor Karim Khan has been dismissed following an intense 18-month campaign by Israel and its allies to stop him from pursuing arrest warrants against Israeli officials. Despite allegations of misconduct used to justify his removal, reports suggest these claims were politically motivated to discredit his legal actions regarding the situation in Palestine. This unprecedented pressure included direct intimidation, threats of sanctions from foreign governments, and a coordinated media effort to undermine his authority.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ዋና አቃቤ ህግ ከሪም ካን በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ላይ የእስር ማዘዣ በማውጣታቸው ከስልጣናቸው ተነስተዋል። የእስራኤል መንግስት እና አጋሮቹ ካንን ከስልጣን ለማውረድ ለ18 ወራት የዘለቀ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ እና የጫና ዘመቻ ሲያካሂዱ ቆይተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ካን በፍልስጤም ላይ እየተፈጸሙ ባሉ ወንጀሎች ምርመራ እንዲያቆሙ ለማስፈራራት እና ስማቸውን ለማጠልሸት የተደረገ የተቀናጀ ጥረት እንደሆነ ይነገራል።
oromo: Abbaan Alangaa Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa Karim Khaan, hoogganoota Israa'el irratti ajaja hidhaa baasuun isaanii hordofee aangoo irraa kaafamaniiru. Mootummaan Israa'el fi tumsuun ishee, Khaan hojii isaanii akka dhaaban dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi duula waggaa tokko fi walakkaa fudhate gaggeessaa turaniiru. Duulli kun himannaa seeraan ala ta'een kan walqabatu yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaa gurguddoon Khaan qorannoo Falasxiin irratti gaggeessaa turan akka dhaaban dirqisiisuu fi maqaa isaanii balleessuu dha.

title: Israel attacks civilians sheltering at UN school in Gaza, while separate strike kills two
english: Israeli forces launched an attack on Palestinian civilians gathered near a UN-run school in central Gaza, resulting in multiple injuries. In the past day, military strikes across the region have caused additional deaths and casualties, adding to the high toll of lives lost during ongoing violence. These recent events contribute to thousands of civilian fatalities and injuries since the conflict escalated late last year.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በማዕከላዊ ጋዛ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ትምህርት ቤት አካባቢ ተጠልለው የነበሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በተፈጸሙ የቦምብ ድብደባዎች ተጨማሪ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ማለፉና መቁሰላቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ግጭት ከጀመረ ወዲህ እጅግ ብዙ ሲቪሎች ለሞት እና ለጉዳት መዳረጋቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el ganda Deir el-Balah keessatti manneen barnoota UN biratti bakka qubatanii turan irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaafi kanneen biroo kanaan walqabatee namoonni hedduun miidhaniiru akkasumas lubbuun namoota dabalataas darbeera. Haleellaa gurguddaa erga kanaan dura turee as gaggeeffamaa jiruun namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman lubbuun darbuu fi qaama miidhamuu isaanii gabaasichi ibseera.

title: Tehran rejects seeking negotiations with US, confirms Hormuz remains closed
english: Iran's foreign ministry has officially denied seeking any new talks with the United States, labeling such negotiations contrary to their national principles. The country also confirmed that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed following discussions with Oman, emphasizing that these maritime issues are independent of American influence. Additionally, Tehran demanded that France stop interfering in its domestic matters after detaining two French diplomats for allegedly improper activities.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ከአሜሪካ ጋር አዲስ ድርድር የመጀመር ፍላጎት እንደሌለው በይፋ ገልጿል። ሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ከኦማን ጋር ከተደረገ ውይይት በኋላ እንደተዘጋ መሆኑን የገለጹት ቃል አቀባዩ፣ ይህ ውሳኔ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አስረድተዋል። በተጨማሪም በኢራን የውስጥ ጉዳይ ጣልቃ በመግባት ላይ ናቸው ያሉዋቸውን ሁለት የፈረንሳይ ዲፕሎማቶች መያዙን ተከትሎ ፈረንሳይ ድርጊቷን እንድታቆም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimma alaa Iraan marii haaraa Ameerikaa waliin jalqabuuf fedhii akka hin qabne ifatti ibseera. Akkasumas, daandiin galaana Hormuz marii Omaan waliin taasifameen booda cufaa akka ta'e mirkaneessuun, murtoon kun dhiibbaa Ameerikaa irraa walaba ta'uu ibseera. Kana malees, Iraan dippiloomatoota Faransaay lama dhimma biyyattii keessa seenuuf yaalani jedhamu to'annoo jala oolchuun, mootummaan Faransaay gocha akkasii akka dhaabu akeekkachiisteerti.

title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
english: Global oil prices dropped significantly, falling below $88 per barrel, as both the United States and Iran suspended military strikes to allow for potential diplomatic discussions. This recent de-escalation offers hope for stabilizing energy markets after prices had spiked above $100 due to concerns over supply routes. However, experts remain cautious, noting that lasting peace is not guaranteed and that past failed ceasefires have contributed to ongoing market instability.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ወታደራዊ ግጭቶች መቆማቸውን ተከትሎ የዓለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። ሁለቱ አገራት ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት ዕድል ለመስጠት ጥቃቶችን ማቆማቸው በገበያው ላይ እፎይታን የፈጠረ ሲሆን ዋጋውም ከአንድ በርሜል 100 ዶላር በታች ወርዷል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ለውጥ አዎንታዊ ቢሆንም፣ ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች በመፍረሳቸው ባለሙያዎች ለወደፊቱ ገበያ መረጋጋት ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አመለካከት አላቸው።
oromo: gatiin boba'aa addunyaa, walitti bu'iinsi waraanaa gidduu Ameerikaa fi Iraan dhaabbachuu isaatiin gadi bu'eera. Biyyoonni lamaan marii nagayaaf carraa kennuuf jechuun haleellaa waan dhaabaniif, gatiin boba'aa $100 irraa gara $88tti gadi bu'uu danda'eera. Haata'u malee, kanaan dura waliigalteen dhaabbii waraanaa irra deddeebi'amee waan diigameef, ogeeyyonni gabaan gara fuulduraatti akkam akka ta'u of eeggannoon hordofaa jiru.

title: Three dead and several injured in shooting at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle
english: A shooting incident at a food festival near the Space Needle in Seattle resulted in three deaths and multiple injuries, including a young child. Authorities reported that two individuals were firing at each other, with one suspect currently in police custody while the other remains at large. Despite the ongoing investigation, officials have stated that there is no further risk to the community.
amharic: ሲያትል ውስጥ በሚገኘው ስፔስ ኒድል አቅራቢያ በተካሄደ የምግብ በዓል ላይ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ህጻን ልጅን ጨምሮ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ፖሊስ እንደገለጸው ግጭቱ የተፈጠረው እርስ በርስ በሚተኮሱ ሁለት ተጠርጣሪዎች መካከል ሲሆን፣ አንደኛው በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል ሌላኛው ግን አሁንም ፍለጋ ላይ ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው አሁን ምንም አይነት የደህንነት ስጋት እንደሌለ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Siyaatilitti bakka 'Space Needle' jedhamutti ayyaana nyaataa irratti dhukaasa ka'een namoonni sadii du'anii hedduun madaa'aniiru; isaan madaa'an keessas daa'imni xinnoo tokko argama. Poolisoonni akka ibsanitti, dhukaasichi namoota lama gidduutti kan ka'e yoo ta'u, tokko to'annoo jala oolee kan biraa immoo barbaadamaa jira. Qorannoon kan itti fufu ta'us, mootummaan hawaasni sodaachuu akka hin qabne mirkaneesseera.

title: Pirlo out of Italy football top job after backlash over Russian betting firm links
english: Andrea Pirlo is no longer a candidate for the Italian national football coaching position following intense public criticism. Politicians opposed his potential appointment because of his professional ties to a Russian betting company that has been linked to the war in Ukraine. While Pirlo defended his partnership as strictly commercial and sporting, the backlash forced him to withdraw from contention.
amharic: ከሩሲያ የውርርድ ድርጅት ጋር ባለው ግንኙነት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ትችት በመሰንዘሩ አንድሪያ ፒርሎ የጣሊያን ብሔራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ የመሆን ዕድሉ ተጠናቋል። ፖለቲከኞች ፒርሎ ከዩክሬን ጦርነት ጋር በተያያዘ ስሙ ከሚነሳ የሩሲያ ኩባንያ ጋር መሥራታቸውን በመቃወም አሰልጣኝ እንዳይሆኑ ተጽዕኖ አድርገዋል። ፒርሎ ግንኙነቱ ከስፖርት እና ንግድ ጋር ብቻ የተያያዘ እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ ከከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ በኋላ ውድድሩን ለቋል።
oromo: Andrea Pirlo hariiroo inni dhaabbata gamoo (betting) Raashiyaa tokko waliin qabu irratti mormiin guddaan erga kaee booda, hojii leenjisummaa garee biyyaalessa Xaaliyaanii akka hin arganne ibsameera. Paartiileen siyaasaa, walitti dhufeenyi inni dhaabbata Raashiyaa waraana Yukreen wajjin walqabatu kana waliin qabu fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu dubbachuun isa balaaleffataniiru. Pirloon hojiin isaa kun dhimma daldalaa fi ispoortii qofa ta'uu ibsuuf yaalus, mormii guddaa isa mudateen booda carraa isaa dhiiseera.

title: Bali bans Dutch expats whose run club allegedly excluded Indonesians
english: Indonesian authorities have banned two Dutch citizens from re-entering the country after they organized a running event without the required permits. The organizers faced intense public criticism over accusations that their group, Entourage Bali, was excluding locals while favoring foreigners. While the club claimed the exclusion was a technical error, the incident has highlighted rising tensions between local residents and the growing expatriate community in Bali.
amharic: የኢንዶኔዥያ ባለሥልጣናት ያለምንም ህጋዊ ፈቃድ የማራቶን ዝግጅት ያዘጋጁ ሁለት የደች ዜጎችን ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዳይገቡ ከልክለዋል። አዘጋጆቹ ‘ኢንቱሬጅ ባሊ’ የተሰኘው ቡድናቸው የሀገር ውስጥ ነዋሪዎችን በማግለል የውጭ ዜጎችን ብቻ እንዲሳተፉ ማድረጉ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቶ ነበር። ምንም እንኳን አዘጋጆቹ መገለሉ በቴክኒክ ስህተት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ ክስተቱ በባሊ ነዋሪዎች እና በውጭ ሀገር ዜጎች መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣውን አለመግባባት በይፋ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Indooneeshiyaa lammiilee Nezerlaandi lamaan hayyama malee sagantaa fiigichaa qindeessuu isaaniitiin biyyattii akka hin seenne dhorkeera. Gurmuun kun ‘Entourage Bali’ jedhamu, lammiilee biyyaattiin ala ta’an qofa qabachuu fi namoota biyya keessaa akka hin hirmaanne gochuu isaatiin mormii cimaa uumee ture. Gareen kun dhimmi kun dogoggora teeknikaa ta’uu isaa ibsuyyuu, rakkoon kun walitti buiinsa jiraattota naannichaa fi namoota biyya alaa gidduutti uumamee jiru bal’inaan ifa baaseera.

title: Sooryavanshi praised by Laxman after teen stars against Zimbabwe in T20
english: Indian teenage cricket talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was named player of the series after helping his team secure a 3-0 victory against Zimbabwe. Coach VVS Laxman praised the 15-year-old's impressive growth and maturity, noting his ability to bounce back from earlier struggles in England. While the coach highlighted the young player's eagerness and determination, he emphasized that continued improvements in physical fitness will be essential for his long-term success.
amharic: የህንድ ታዳጊ የክሪኬት ተጫዋች ቫይብሃቭ ሱርያቫንሺ በዚምባቡዌ ላይ በተደረገው ተከታታይ ጨዋታ ቡድኑ 3-0 እንዲያሸንፍ በማገዙ የውድድሩ ምርጥ ተጫዋች ተብሎ ተመርጧል። አሰልጣኝ ቪቪኤስ ላክስማን የ15 ዓመቱን ወጣት ብስለት እና ከእንግሊዝ ጉዞ በኋላ ያሳየውን የአቋም መሻሻል አድንቀዋል። አሰልጣኙ የተጫዋቹን ትጋት ያደነቁ ቢሆንም፣ በቀጣይ ለስኬታማነቱ የአካል ብቃቱን የበለጠ ማሻሻል እንደሚጠበቅበት ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Taphatni kirikeetii dargaggeessi Hindii Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, gareen isaa Zimbaabuwee irratti injifannoo 3-0 akka gonfatu gargaaruun taphattoota dorgommii kanaa hunda keessaa beekamtii argateera. Leenjisuun isaa VVS Laxman dargaggeessa umrii 15 kanaa guddinaa fi bilchina inni agarsiise akkasumas rakkoo kanaan dura Ingilaandiitti isa mudate mo'ee deebi'uu isaa dinqisiifateera. Leenjisuun kun fedhii fi murannoo taphatichaa kan jajaban yoo ta'u, milkaa'ina isaaf gara fuulduraatti cimina qaamaa isaa irratti hojjechuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibseera.

title: Photos: France, Spain battle ‘monster’ wildfires as more heat looms
english: France and Spain are currently struggling to contain massive wildfires that have displaced over 325,000 people. These intense fires have been fueled by extreme heatwaves and prolonged drought, with experts attributing the severity of the situation to climate change. As emergency services work to protect vulnerable areas, officials have warned that the threat remains high due to the expected arrival of even hotter temperatures.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ እና ስፔን ከ325,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው ያፈናቀሉ መጠነ ሰፊ የደን ቃጠሎዎችን ለመቆጣጠር እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ከፍተኛ የደን ቃጠሎዎች በከባድ የሙቀት ማዕበል እና በድርቅ ምክንያት የተከሰቱ ሲሆን፣ ባለሙያዎች ለዚህ አስከፊ ክስተት የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ዋና ምክንያት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ድንገተኛ አደጋ ተቆጣጣሪዎች አካባቢውን ለመታደግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ በቀጣይ ቀናት የሚጠበቀው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ስጋቱን አባብሶታል።
oromo: Faransaayi fi Ispeen namoota 325,000 ol qe’ee isaanii irraa buqqise balaa ibidda bosonaa guddaa to’achuuf wal’aansoo gochaa jiru. Ibiddoonni kun ho’a qilleensaa cimaa fi hongeen kan babal’atan yoo ta’u, ogeeyyiin jijjiiramni qilleensaa sababa guddaa balaa kanaa ta’uu ibsu. Tajaajilli ariifachiisaan iddoowwan miidhaman oolchuuf tattaaffii godhuus, ho’i qilleensaa dabaluun isaa balaa kana caalatti hamaa akka godhuuf sodaatama.

title: Moment Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Belgorod
english: Ukrainian drones recently launched an attack on the Russian border city of Belgorod, causing significant damage. According to local officials, the strike left at least 12 individuals injured, including two young children. This incident highlights the ongoing escalation of the conflict between the two nations.
amharic: የዩክሬን ድሮኖች በሩሲያ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው በቤልጎሮድ ከተማ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ በጥቃቱ ሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የጦርነት ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Xiyyaaroonni malee kan Yukreen magaalota daangaa Raashiyaa keessa jirtu Belgorod irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Aangeyyoonni biyyattii akka ibsanitti, haleellaa kanaan yoo xiqqaate namoonni 12 kan miidhaman yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa ijoolleen lama ni argamu. Taateen kun walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru daran hammeenya agarsiisa.

title: Why has the US halted its bombing of Iran?
english: The United States has suspended its recent military strikes against Iran following a period of intense conflict. Reports suggest this pause may be due to a shortage of air defense supplies, though the government has officially denied this. Both nations have currently stopped their retaliatory attacks, leading to a slight drop in global oil prices and raising hopes for a diplomatic solution to the ongoing regional tension.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር የነበረው ከፍተኛ ግጭት ከተቀዘቀዘ በኋላ በሀገሪቱ ላይ ሲያደርስ የነበረውን የአየር ጥቃት አቁሟል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው አሜሪካ የመከላከያ የጦር መሳሪያዎች እጥረት ስላጋጠማት ሊሆን እንደሚችል የሚጠቁሙ ዘገባዎች ቢኖሩም መንግስት ይህንን አስተባብሏል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት በቀል የተሞላበት ጥቃታቸውን በመግታታቸው የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲቀንስ እና ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄዎች በር እንዲከፈት ተስፋ ተጥሏል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi cimaan erga uumamee booda, Amerikaan haleellaa airaa Iraan irratti gaggeessaa turte dhaabdeetti. Sababa haleellaa kana dhaabuu kanatti kan hidhataniis, Amerikaan meeshaalee waraanaa xiyyaaraa irratti itti fayyadaman dhabuu ishee kan ibsan gabaasonni ni jiru, ta'us mootummaan ishee oduu kana haaleera. Gareen lamaanuu haleellaa wal-irraa hirtu dhaabuu isaaniitiin, gatiin boba'aa addunyaa xiqqoo hir'ateera, akkasumas karaa dippilomaasii rakkoo kana furuuf abdii uumeera.

title: Israeli forces storm multiple West Bank towns, settler violence worsens
english: Israeli military forces have launched a widespread offensive across the occupied West Bank, conducting raids in at least 20 towns and villages. During these operations, soldiers have demolished homes, detained dozens of Palestinians, and allegedly obstructed emergency medical care, resulting in severe consequences. Concurrently, Jewish settlers have increased their violent attacks on Palestinian homes and farms, while authorities continue to focus arrests on Palestinians rather than addressing settler aggression.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ በቢያንስ 20 ከተሞችና መንደሮች ላይ ሰፊ ወረራ አካሂደዋል። በዚህ ዘመቻ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ ቤቶችን በማፍረስና በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያንን በማሰር ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ አምቡላንሶችን በማገታቸውም ከባድ የጤና ቀውሶች እየተፈጠሩ ነው። በአንጻሩ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በፈረንጆች የሚፈጽሙት ጥቃት እየተባባሰ ቢመጣም፣ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ሰፋሪዎችን ከመቆጣጠር ይልቅ በፈረንጆቹ ላይ እስሮችን በማብዛት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa jiru (West Bank) keessatti magaalota fi gandaa 20 ol ta'an irratti duula bal'aa gaggeessaa jiru. Duula kanaan mana jireenyaa diiganii fi namoota hedduu hidhaatti darbaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, namoota gargaarsa ariifataa barbaadan karaatti gufuu ta'uun isaanii balaa hamaa geessiseera. Gammachuu biroo kanaan, qubattoonni Israa'el qabeenyaa fi mana warra Falasxiin irratti haleellaa raawwatan kan dabale yoo ta'u, humnoonni naga eegsisootaa garuu qubattoota kana to'achuu mannaa, namoota Falasxiin irratti tarkaanfii hidhaa fudhachuu filataniiru.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopian politics is undergoing a major shift as proposed constitutional reforms move away from the traditional central influence of Amhara political thought. The transition from the old coalition-based power structure to the Prosperity Party's system of demographic majoritarianism means that political power is now tied more to regional population size. As a result, Amhara political groups face the significant challenge of adjusting to a peripheral role in the nation's changing governance structure.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ፖለቲካ በአዲስ የሕገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ ሀሳቦች ሳቢያ ትልቅ ለውጥ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የአማራ ፖለቲካዊ አስተሳሰብ ከነበረው የማዕከላዊ ተፅእኖ እንዲርቅ እያደረገው ነው። ቀደም ሲል የነበረው የጥምረት የሥልጣን አወቃቀር ወደ ብልፅግና ፓርቲ የቁጥር የበላይነት ሥርዓት በመሸጋገሩ፣ የፖለቲካ ሥልጣን በቀጥታ ከክልሎች የህዝብ ብዛት ጋር ተያይዟል። በዚህም ምክንያት የአማራ የፖለቲካ ኃይሎች በሀገሪቱ እየተቀየረ ባለው የመንግስት አስተዳደር ውስጥ ያላቸውን ሚና እንደገና የመገምገም ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሟቸዋል።
oromo: Siyaasni Itiyoophiyaa jijjiirama guddaa keessa jiraachuun, caasaan mootummaa fi mootummaan biyyattii akka kanaan duraa bu’uura Amhara irratti kan hin hundoofne ta’uu isaa ibsa. Mootummaan badhaadhinaa sirna itti fayyadama lakkoofsa ummataa irratti hundaa’uun aangootti fayyadamuun, dhiibbaa siyaasaa kanaan dura ture jijjiireera. Jijjiiramni kun humnoota siyaasaa Amharaaf gahee siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti qaban haala haaraan akka madaalan isaan dirqisiiseera.

title: 'This is just the start': India's Gen Z protesters force out a minister, but what next?
english: In a rare political shift, Indian youth protesters successfully pressured Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan to resign following widespread anger over a major medical exam scandal. The movement gained momentum through viral social media campaigns that bypassed mainstream media control, highlighting a new wave of digital-native activism. While this resignation marks a significant win for the younger generation, activists are now focused on pushing for broader education reforms and justice for affected families.
amharic: በህንድ በአንድ የህክምና መግቢያ ፈተና ላይ በተፈጠረ የጥያቄ ወረቀት መፍሰስ ሳቢያ በተቀሰቀሰ ተቃውሞ፣ የሀገሪቱ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር ධርሜንድራ ፕራዳን ከስልጣናቸው እንዲለቁ ተገደዋል። ወጣቶች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመጠቀም ያደራጁት ይህ የተቃውሞ ንቅናቄ፣ በመንግስት ላይ ለውጥ ማምጣት እንደሚቻል ያሳየ ትልቅ ድል ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ አሁን ትኩረታቸውን በትምህርት ስርዓቱ ላይ ለውጥ ለማምጣት እና ጉዳት ለደረሰባቸው ቤተሰቦች ፍትህ ለማግኘት ላይ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti qorumsa seensaa fayyaa irratti rakkoo hatamuu gaaffiiwwanii hordofee, barattoonniifi dargaggoonni mormii guddaa gaggeessaniin Ministirri Barnootaa Dharmendiraa Piraadaan aangoo gadi akka lakkisan dirqisiisaniiru. Dargaggoonni kun miidiyaa hawaasaatti fayyadamuu dhaan mormii kana bakka bu’iinsa guddaa irraan ga’aniiru, kunis humna dargaggoonni jijjiirama fiduuf qaban kan agarsiise ta’eera. Amma garuu, mormitoonni kun fedhiin isaanii inni guddaan sirna barnootaa fooyyessuufi maatii miidhaan irra ga’eef haqaa argamsiisuu dha.

title: Rapper Yung Filly tells trial 'vibes were good' with woman who accuses him of rape
english: British rapper Yung Filly, whose real name is Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos, is currently on trial in Australia facing multiple charges of sexual assault and violence. During his testimony, the performer denied the accusations and claimed that his interaction with the accuser was consensual and positive. The trial continues as the court examines the events that took place in his hotel room following a concert performance last year.
amharic: አንድሬስ ፌሊፔ ቫለንሲያ ባሪየንቶስ በመባል የሚታወቀው የብሪታኒያው ራፐር ያንግ ፊሊ በአውስትራሊያ የጾታ ጥቃት እና የጉዳት ክሶች ቀርበውበት ክርክር እያደረገ ነው። ራፐሩ በችሎት ፊት ባቀረበው ምስክርነት ክሱ የፈጠራ ወሬ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ከተከሰሰችው ሴት ጋር የነበረው ግንኙነት በስምምነት ላይ የተመሠረተ እንደነበር ተናግሯል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ካለፈው ዓመት ኮንሰርት በኋላ በሆቴል ክፍል ውስጥ የተፈጠረውን ክስተት በማጣራት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Raapperiin biyya Ingilizii Yung Filly jedhamu, maqaan isaa dhugaan Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos, Awustiraaliyaatti himata gudeeddii fi miidhaa qaamaa irratti dhiyaatee falmaa jira. Abbaa alangaa fi mana murtiitti akka ibsetti, namichi himata irratti dhiyaate kana waakkachuun, waliigaltee waliin akka qabaatan ibseera. Mana murtichi guyyaa har'aa waayee gareen kun hootela keessatti wal argatan irratti ragaa fi falmii dhaggeeffachuu itti fufeera.

title: Argentinian leader calls Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'
english: Argentinian President Javier Milei recently insulted Brazil's leader, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, by labeling him a thief and a convict during a political rally in Sao Paulo. In response to these remarks made while supporting a right-wing candidate, the Brazilian government decided to recall its ambassador from Buenos Aires. President Lula rejected the interference, emphasizing that Brazil maintains its own sovereignty despite these diplomatic tensions.
amharic: የአርጀንቲናው ፕሬዚዳንት ሃቪየር ሚሌይ በሳኦ ፓውሎ በተደረገ የፖለቲካ ስብሰባ ላይ የብራዚሉን መሪ ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫን ሌባ እና ወንጀለኛ በማለት ተችተዋል። ይህንን ተከትሎ የብራዚል መንግስት በአርጀንቲና የሚገኘውን አምባሳደሩን ወደ ሀገሩ እንዲመለስ አድርጓል። ፕሬዚዳንት ሉላ በበኩላቸው የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነትን እንደማይቀበሉ በመግለጽ የአገራቸውን ሉዓላዊነት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Arjentiinaa Javier Milei magaalaa Saawoo Paawuloo keessatti walgahii siyaasaa irratti pirezedantii Biroozil Luwii Iinaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa irratti yakka cimaa fayyadamuun 'hattuu' fi 'hidhamaa' jechuun arrabsaniiru. Gocha kana hordofee mootummaan Biroozil ambaasaaddara isaanii Arjentiinaa jiru gara biyyaatti akka deebi'u ajajeera. Pirezedantni Luulaa gama isaaniin, biyyi isaanii qaama alaa kamiyyuu akka hin seene himuun, kabajaa fi bilisummaa biyya isaanii akka eeggatan ibsaniiru.

title: The AI military complex: Which are the main companies in it?
english: Military strategies are shifting from traditional hardware to advanced software, as global governments invest billions into artificial intelligence for modern warfare. Major technology companies are now securing massive contracts to provide autonomous drones, data processing tools, and decision-making software for defense agencies. This transformation marks a new era where battles are increasingly fought through screens and sophisticated digital platforms.
amharic: የዓለም መንግስታት በዘመናዊ ጦርነት ውስጥ ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎትን (AI) ለመጠቀም በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠር ዶላር ኢንቨስት እያደረጉ በመሆኑ፣ ወታደራዊ ስልቶች ከባህላዊ መሳሪያዎች ወደ ዘመናዊ ሶፍትዌሮች እየተቀየሩ ነው። ዋና ዋና የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖችን፣ የመረጃ ማቀነባበሪያ መሳሪያዎችን እና ወሳኝ ውሳኔዎችን የሚወስኑ ሶፍትዌሮችን ለጦር ሰራዊት ለማቅረብ ትላልቅ ውሎችን እየተፈራረሙ ነው። ይህ ለውጥ ጦርነቶች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ በስክሪን እና በተራቀቁ ዲጂታል መድረኮች የሚካሄዱበትን አዲስ ምዕራፍ እያመጣ ነው።
oromo: Mootummoonni addunyaa waraana ammayyeessuuf teeknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' irratti biliyoonaan lakkaawwamu baasii gochaa waan jiraniif, tarsiimoon waraanaa meeshaalee aadaarraa gara sooftiweerii fooyya'aatti jijjiiramaa jira. Kompaniileen teeknoolojii gurguddoonis dooniiwwan ofiin balali'an, meeshaalee odeeffannoo qindeessan fi sooftiweerii murtoo kennan waraanaaf dhiheessuuf waligaltee gurguddaa mallatteessaa jiru. Jijjiiramni kun waraanni gara fuulduraatti bal'inaan iskiiriinii fi meeshaalee dijitaalaan kan gaggeeffamu ta'uusaa agarsiisa.

title: Tadej Pogacar wins Tour de France for a record-equalling fifth time
english: Tadej Pogacar has secured his fifth Tour de France title, matching the legendary record held by four other cyclists. The Slovenian rider achieved this victory by winning three consecutive races and dominating the competition throughout the event. While Mathieu van der Poel won the final stage in Paris, Pogacar’s overall performance solidified his status as the best cyclist in the world today.
amharic: ታዴጅ ፖጋቻር በአምስት የቱር ደ ፍራንስ ድሎች ሌሎች አራት አፈ ታሪክ የብስክሌት ስፖርተኞችን በመቀላቀል ታሪካዊ ውጤት አስመዝግቧል። የስሎቬኒያው ተወዳዳሪ ይህንን ድል የተቀዳጀው ተከታታይ ሶስት ውድድሮችን በማሸነፍ ሲሆን በውድድሩ በሙሉ ብልጫውን አሳይቷል። ማቲዩ ቫን ደር ፖል የመጨረሻውን የፓሪስ ምዕራፍ ቢያሸንፍም፣ ፖጋቻር በአጠቃላይ ውጤቱ የዘንድሮውን የውድድር ዘመን አሸናፊ በመሆን አቅሙን አረጋግጧል።

title: German arms export licences for Israel surge with focus on sub project
english: Germany has significantly increased its military export approvals to Israel, authorizing nearly 800 million euros in weapons during the first five months of 2026. The majority of this funding is directed toward a major maritime project, widely believed to be the delivery of a new, nuclear-capable submarine built by TKMS. This surge in support comes despite official German concerns regarding the ongoing military conflict in Gaza.
amharic: ጀርመን እ.ኤ.አ. በ2026 በመጀመሪያዎቹ አምስት ወራት ውስጥ ወደ እስራኤል የምታደርገውን የወታደራዊ መሳሪያ ላኪነት ፍቃድ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ጨምራለች። አብዛኛው የዚህ ፈቃድ ድጋፍ በባህር ኃይል ፕሮጀክት ላይ ያተኮረ ሲሆን ይህም በቲኬኤምኤስ (TKMS) የተሰራው የኒውክሌር መያዝ አቅም ያለው የሰርጓጅ መርከብ ግዥ እንደሆነ ይገመታል። ይህ የጀርመን ድጋፍ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ካለው ጦርነት ጋር ተያይዞ በበርሊን በኩል ስጋት ቢኖርም የተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Jarmanii ji'oota shanan jalqaba bara 2026 keessatti, meeshaalee waraanaa gara Israa'elitti ergamuuf hayyama baay'ee guddaa ta'e kenniteetti. Hayyamni kun kaffaltii Euro miliyoona 800 ol kan qabu yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa baay'een isaa hojii gamoo galaanaa irratti kan ooluu fi markaba duubee (submarine) nukilera fe'uu danda'u kan TKMS oomishe bituuf kan oolu akka ta'e dubbatama. Gargaarsi kun guddachuu kan danda'e, mootummaan Jarmanii waraana Gaaza keessatti adeemaa jiruuf yaaddoo qabaachuu ishee ibsitu illee, Israa'eliif deggarsa waraanaa kennuu hin dhaabin.

title: Iran warns Ukraine of retaliation after deadly Caspian Sea strike
english: Iran has threatened retaliation against Ukraine following a deadly strike on an Iranian commercial ship in the Caspian Sea that resulted in casualties. Iranian officials condemned the attack as a violation of international law and accused Israel of inciting the incident to expand the regional conflict. While Ukraine claims the vessel was involved in transporting military cargo, Iran denies any involvement in the Russia-Ukraine war and has summoned a Ukrainian diplomat to protest the action.

title: Climate change presents new threat to Philippines’ UNESCO rice terraces
english: The historic Ifugao rice terraces in the Philippines, a UNESCO World Heritage site, are facing severe destruction from increasingly frequent and intense extreme weather events. Landslides caused by recent typhoons have already damaged critical irrigation systems and farmlands, threatening the traditional livelihoods of local farmers. Limited government support makes it difficult for the community to protect this ancient cultural landmark against the growing impacts of climate change.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ የሚገኙትና የዩኔስኮ የዓለም ቅርስ የሆኑት የኢፉጋዎ የሩዝ እርከኖች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየተባባሰ በመጣው አስከፊ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ላይ ወድቀዋል። በቅርቡ በተከሰቱ ኃይለኛ አውሎ ነፋሶች ምክንያት የተፈጠሩ የመሬት መንሸራተቶች የውኃ ማስተላለፊያ መስመሮችን እና የእርሻ መሬቶችን በማውደማቸው የአካባቢውን ገበሬዎች ኑሮ አደጋ ላይ ጥለዋል። መንግስት በቂ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ እየተቸገረ በመሆኑ፣ ይህ ጥንታዊ የባህል መዳረሻ በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት ለሚደርስበት ጉዳት ተጋላጭ ሆኗል።

Mootummaan deeggarsa gahaa gochuu waan hin dandeenyeef, bakki seena qabeessi kun balaa jijjiirama qilleensaa irraa of ittisuuf rakkachaa jira.

title: Tell killings: Does the right of self-defence apply only to Jews?
english: Four Palestinians and two Israelis were killed following a violent confrontation in the West Bank village of Tell after armed settlers entered the area. While Israeli authorities labeled the incident a terror attack, local witnesses and video footage suggest the settlers initiated the conflict. This event has raised significant questions about the actions of settlers in Palestinian territories and highlights the unequal application of self-defense justifications in the region.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ቴል መንደር በተፈጠረ የሁከት ግጭት አራት ፍልስጤማውያን እና ሁለት እስራኤላውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ክስተቱን የሽብር ጥቃት ሲሉት፣ የአይን እማኞች እና የተለቀቁ ምስሎች ግጭቱን የጀመሩት ታጣቂ ሰፋሪዎች መሆናቸውን ያሳያሉ። ይህ ክስተት በፍልስጤም ግዛቶች ውስጥ ሰፋሪዎች ስለሚፈጽሙት ድርጊት እና በክልሉ ስለሚታየው የራስን መከላከል መብት አጠቃቀም ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Naannoo Zoonii Lixaa ganda Tell jedhamu keessatti walitti bu'iinsa uumameen namoonni Falasxiin afurifi Israa'el lama ajjeeffamaniiru. Mootummaan Israa'el gochicha akka haleellaa shororkeessummaatti yoo ibsu, ragooleenifi viidiyoon garaagaraa garuu haleellaan kan jalqabame qubattoota meeshaan hidhataniin akka ta'e argisiisu. Gochi kun qubattoonni naannoo Falasxiin keessa socho'uuf mirga qabaachuu isaanii fi mirgi of ittisuu jedhu haala wal-qixa hin taaneen fayyadamaa jiraachuu isaarratti gaaffii guddaa uumeera.

title: Pregnant Palestinian woman loses child after Israeli forces obstruct ambulance
english: A pregnant Palestinian woman lost her unborn child after Israeli soldiers blocked an ambulance from passing through a military checkpoint near Nablus. The medical team was forced to turn off their vehicle, causing essential life-saving equipment to stop working while the woman faced critical health complications. Additionally, officials reported that the soldiers delayed the transport by detaining a crew member and conducting a search during the emergency.

title: Lebanese army condemns ongoing Israeli 'attacks and violations'
english: The Lebanese military has criticized ongoing Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon, stating that these actions violate international laws and existing agreements. The army claims these operations are destroying infrastructure and hindering their ability to deploy forces effectively to the region. Consequently, these hostilities are preventing displaced citizens from safely returning to their homes.

title: Israeli forces storm homes in south Syria
english: Israeli military personnel conducted an operation in southern Syria's Daraa province early Monday morning. During this raid, soldiers searched multiple residential properties in the village of al-Ardah. The activity was reportedly accompanied by significant gunfire throughout the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሰኞ ዕለት ማለዳ በሶሪያ ደቡባዊ ክፍል በሚገኘው የዳራ ግዛት ውስጥ ዘመቻ አካሂደዋል። በዚህ ወረራ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ በአል-አርዳህ መንደር የሚገኙ በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ፈትሸዋል። ድርጊቱ በከፍተኛ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ታጅቦ እንደነበር ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el ganama Wiixata darbe naannoo Daraa, kibba Sooriyaatti duula gaggeessaniiru. Duula kanaanis, waraanni sun baadiyyaa al-Ardah keessatti manneen jireenyaa hedduu sakatta'aniiru. Gochi kunis dhukaasa cimaan kan deggerame akka ture gabaasameera.

title: Thousands march in Pakistan-administered Kashmir amid election unrest
english: Large crowds have marched in Pakistan-administered Kashmir to protest against governance issues and planned electoral changes. This unrest follows a violent period since June that has resulted in dozens of deaths and hundreds of injuries. Demonstrators are moving toward Muzaffarabad as tensions remain high ahead of the upcoming regional elections.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር ውስጥ በአስተዳደር ችግሮች እና በምርጫ ማሻሻያ እቅድ ላይ በመቃወም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። ከሰኔ ወር ጀምሮ በክልሉ በተከሰተው ግጭት ከ45 በላይ ሰዎች ሲሞቱ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቆስለዋል። የክልሉ ምርጫ እየተቃረበ ባለበት በዚህ ወቅት ተቃዋሚዎች ወደ ሙዛፋራባድ በመጓዝ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Godina Paakistaanin bulfamu kan Kaashmiir keessatti, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman rakkoo bulchiinsaa fi jijjiirama seera filannoo mormuuf hiriira ba'aniiru. Akkaataa walitti bu'iinsa ji'a Waxabajjii irraa kaasee ture kanaan, namoonni 45 ol du'anii fi dhibbootaan lakkaawaman miidhamaniiru. Filannoon naannichaa dhiyaachaa waan jiruuf, hiriirtonni gara Muzaffarabaditti imalaa jiru.

title: Sudan’s army claims control of major highway linking Khartoum and el-Obeid
english: The Sudanese military has successfully recaptured the Al Sadarat highway, a vital supply route connecting Khartoum to the city of el-Obeid. By defeating the Rapid Support Forces after intense fighting, the army has secured a direct path to transport essential military supplies and aid. This strategic victory is expected to relieve the pressure on el-Obeid, where half a million people have been trapped under the paramilitary group's siege.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር ከካርቱም ወደ ኤል-ኦቤይድ የሚያገናኘውን ዋና አውራ ጎዳና ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠሩን አስታውቋል። ጦሩ ከባድ ውጊያ በማድረግ አውራ ጎዳናውን ከተቆጣጠሩት የፈጣን ድጋፍ ኃይሎች ነጥቆ ወታደራዊ አቅርቦቶችን እና ሰብአዊ እርዳታዎችን ለማድረስ መንገድ ከፍቷል። ይህ ድል ለወራት በበባህርይ እገታ ስር የቆየውን የኤል-ኦቤይድ ከተማ ጫና ለማቃለል እና በአካባቢው የሚገኙ ግማሽ ሚሊዮን ሰዎችን ለመታደግ ትልቅ ሚና ይኖረዋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Sudaan karaa guddaa Kaartum fi magaalaa el-Obeid wal quunnisiisu guutumaatti to’annoo isaa jala oolchuu beeksiseera. Waraana cimaa booda humnoota 'Rapid Support Forces' injifachuun, raayyaan kun meeshaalee waraanaa fi gargaarsa namoomaa hatattamaan geejjibuuf karaa banateera. Injifannoon kun magaalaa el-Obeid keessatti namoota kuma dhibba shan ta’an kan turan irratti dhiibbaa jiru salphisuuf akkasumas gargaarsa barbaachisu dhaqqabsiisuuf gumaacha guddaa qaba.

title: Vendor’s livestream captures chaos as gunfire erupts at Seattle Center
english: A shooting incident occurred at the Bite of Seattle festival near the Space Needle, which was accidentally recorded by a vendor during a live broadcast. The violent event resulted in the deaths of at least two individuals. Additionally, five people were injured in the attack, including a two-year-old toddler.
amharic: በሲያትል ሴንተር በተካሄደው 'ባይት ኦፍ ሲያትል' ፌስቲቫል ላይ የተኩስ እሩምታ ተከስቷል፣ ይህም በአንድ ሻጭ የቀጥታ ስርጭት ወቅት በቪዲዮ ተቀድቷል። በዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ቢያንስ ሁለት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በተጨማሪም የአንድ ሁለት ዓመት ሕፃን ልጅን ጨምሮ አምስት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል።

Dhukaasa kanaan namoonni lama battalumatti du'aniiru. Kana malees, daa'ima waggaa lamaa dabalatee namoonni biroo shan madaa'aniiru.

title: Sudan’s army regains control of highway linking Khartoum with El Obeid
english: The Sudanese military has successfully recaptured the Al Sadarat highway, which serves as a vital route connecting the capital, Khartoum, to the city of El Obeid. El Obeid had previously been surrounded by forces from the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces. This development marks a significant shift in control over key infrastructure in the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር ከካርቱም ወደ ኤል ኦቤድ ከተማ የሚያገናኘውን አል ሳዳራት የተባለውን ዋና መንገድ በቁጥጥሩ ስር አውሏል። ኤል ኦቤድ ከተማ ከዚህ ቀደም በራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርሰስ ታጣቂዎች ከበባ ውስጥ ትገኝ ነበር። ይህ የጦር ሰራዊቱ እንቅስቃሴ በሀገሪቱ በሚካሄደው ግጭት ውስጥ ቁልፍ የሆነ የመሰረተ ልማት መንገድን መልሶ ለመቆጣጠር ያስቻለ ትልቅ ለውጥ ነው።
