title: Russia and Ukraine trade attacks, killing 10, including child in Chernihiv
english: Russian and Ukrainian forces exchanged deadly aerial attacks over the weekend, resulting in the deaths of at least ten people. Russian missile and drone strikes across several Ukrainian cities hit residential areas and a supermarket, killing a young girl and several others. Meanwhile, officials in Russian-occupied territory reported that Ukrainian drone strikes resulted in four additional fatalities in the city of Horlivka.
amharic: የሩሲያ እና የዩክሬን ኃይሎች በሳምንቱ መጨረሻ ባደረጉት የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ አስር ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የሩሲያ ሚሳኤሎች እና ድሮኖች በበርካታ የዩክሬን ከተሞች ውስጥ በሚገኙ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች እና አንድ ሱፐርማርኬት ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት አንዲት ህጻን ልጅን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። በሌላ በኩል በሩሲያ ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የሆርሊቭካ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የዩክሬን ድሮን ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች መገደላቸውን የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humnoota Raashiyaa fi Yuukreyn gidduutti dhukaasni amba qilleensaa torban dhumaa keessa geggeeffame lubbuu namoota kudhanii galaafateera. Raashiyaan magaalota Yuukreyn keessatti iddoowwan namoonni jiraatan fi suuqii gurgurtaa irratti miisaa'elii fi doroniin miidhaa geessisteen intalli xinniittii tokko dabalatee namoonni hedduun ajjeefamaniiru. Gama biraatiin, magaalaa Hoorliivkaa kan Raashiyaan qabatte keessatti dhukaasa doonii Yuukreynin namoonni afur du'uu isaanii angawoonni Raashiyaa beeksisaniiru.

title: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' after arrest threat
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has criticized New York official Zohran Mamdani for previously threatening to arrest him over alleged war crimes. Mamdani later admitted he lacks the legal authority to enforce an International Criminal Court warrant. Netanyahu accused the official of spreading division and hate, specifically noting rising safety concerns for Jewish residents in the city.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ፣ የኒውዮርክ ከተማ ባለስልጣን ዞህራን ማምዳኒ በእሳቸው ላይ የእስር ዛቻ በማድረጋቸው ተችተዋቸዋል። ማምዳኒ በኋላ ላይ ዓለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ላይ ባወጣው የቁጥጥር ትዕዛዝ መሰረት እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ህጋዊ ስልጣን እንደሌላቸው አምነዋል። ኔታንያሁ ባለስልጣኑ ጥላቻን በመዝራት ማህበረሰቡን ለመከፋፈል እየሞከሩ ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahuun, aangawaa magaalaa Niiwu Yoork Zohraan Maamdanii qabamuuf yaalii taasisaniin erga isaan qeeqanii booda, kun jibbiinsa kan facaasu ta'uu ibsan. Maamdaniin boodarratti aangoo seerawaa mana murtii yakka addunyaa raawwachuuf akka hin qabne beekanii jiru. Netanyaahuun aangawaan kun ummata gargar qooduuf jecha jibbiinsa kakaasaa jiraachuun himatanii jiru.

title: Guterres tours Syria’s notorious ‘Assad Prison’ in Sednaya
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres visited the Sednaya prison in Syria, marking the first time a UN chief has traveled to the country since 2009. This facility is widely recognized as a site of extreme brutality where the Syrian government has held, tortured, and killed many people. By touring this notorious location, the UN leader has brought renewed international attention to the severe human rights abuses committed within the regime's detention system.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሃፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ በሶሪያ የሚገኘውን ሴድናያ እስር ቤት ጎብኝተዋል፤ ይህም እ.ኤ.አ. ከ2009 ወዲህ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን ወደ ሶሪያ ሲጓዙ የመጀመሪያው ነው። ይህ እስር ቤት የአሳድ መንግስት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ያሰቃየበት እና የገደለበት የጭካኔ ማዕከል በመባል ይታወቃል። ዋና ጸሃፊው ይህንን አስከፊ ቦታ መጎብኘታቸው በሶሪያ እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ለአለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ትኩረት እንዲሰጠው አድርጓል።
oromo: Garee mirkaneessaa tokkummaa mootummootaa Antonio Guterres mana hidhaa Sednaya kan biyya Sooriyaa keessatti argamu daawwataniiru. Kunis gorsaan tokkummaa mootummootaa waggaa 2009 booda yeroo jalqabaaf biyyattii daawwatu dha. Mana hidhaa kana keessatti mootummaan Sooriyaa namoota baay'ee dararaa fi ajjeesaa akka ture beekama. Daawwannaan kun yakka mirga namoomaa mana hidhaa san keessatti raawwatameef xiyyeeffannoo addunyaa akka deebi'u taasiseera.

title: Iran war live: Tehran halts retaliatory strikes after pause in US attacks
english: The United States has suspended its two-week bombing campaign against Iran, resulting in a corresponding halt to retaliatory strikes from Tehran. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump has publicly rejected claims that the military is experiencing shortages of ammunition. He asserted that the country maintains substantial stockpiles that are more than sufficient for current needs.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኢራን ላይ ሲያካሂድ የቆየውን የሁለት ሳምንት የቦምብ ጥቃት ያቆመ ሲሆን፣ በምላሹም የኢራን መንግስት በአካባቢው ሲፈጽም የነበረውን የአጸፋ ጥቃት አቁሟል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት እያለቀ መሆኑን የሚገልጹ ዘገባዎችን ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የአገሪቱ የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት ለፍላጎቱ በቂ እና ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa duula gama xiyyaaraan irratti gaggeessaa ture dhaabuun isaa, mootummaan Iraanis tarkaanfii haaloo bahuu akka dhaabu taasiseera. Gamtaan biroo, pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp gabaasota humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa rasaasa dhabuu isaanii ibsan haalaniiru. Pirezidaantichi qabeenyi waraanaa biyyattii amma jiru kan gahaa fi baay'ee ta'uu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Khamenei ties US-Iran peace deal to Israel ending attacks on Lebanon
english: Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has stated that any potential peace agreement between Iran and the United States is strictly dependent on Israel immediately halting its military operations in Lebanon. He emphasized that protecting Lebanon's territorial integrity is a primary requirement and reaffirmed Iran’s strategic commitment to supporting Hezbollah. This declaration follows reports of stalled diplomatic efforts and recent disagreements regarding the collapse of previous agreements between the nations.
amharic: የኢራኑ ከፍተኛ መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል የሚደረግ ማንኛውም የሰላም ስምምነት በእስራኤል የሊባኖስ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት መቆም ላይ የተመሰረተ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የሊባኖስን የግዛት አንድነት ማስከበር ዋነኛው ቅድመ ሁኔታ መሆኑን የገለጹት መሪው፣ ኢራን ለሂዝቦላህ ያላትን ጠንካራ ድጋፍ ዳግም አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል የነበረው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት በመቀዛቀዙ እና ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ ስምምነቶች በመፈራረሳቸው ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni ol aanoon Iraan Mojtabaa Kaameneen, waliigalteen nagaa Iraanii fi Ameerikaa gidduutti godhamu kamiyyuu akka Israa'el lola Liibaanoos keessatti geggeessitu dhaabdu irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu ibsaniiru. Mirgi Liibaanoos kan kabajamee fi loli Israa'el haala wal-hin gaafanneen dhaabachuu akka qabu ibsuun, Iraan gargaarsa garee Hizbullaahiif qabdu cimsanii ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan bahe, mariin jiddu-galeessa ture gufachuun fi waliigalteen kanaan dura ture diigamuu isaa hordofee dha.

title: Blasts heard in north Iraq
english: Reports have emerged of explosions occurring in Erbil, located in northern Iraq. At this time, the exact cause of these blasts remains unconfirmed. News agencies have not yet been able to independently verify the details of the incident.
amharic: በሰሜን ኢራቅ ኤርቢል ከተማ ውስጥ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ ሪፖርቶች እየወጡ ነው። የፍንዳታዎቹ መንስኤ እስካሁን በውል አልታወቀም። የተለያዩ የዜና አውታሮች የክስተቱን ትክክለኛነት ለማረጋገጥ እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaala Erbil kan kaaba Iraaq keessatti dhukaatin akka dhaga’ame gabaasni ni mul’isa. Sababa dhukaatii kanaa hanga ammaatti ifa miti. Miidiyaaleen gabaasichaa dhuga ta’uu isaa mirkaneeffachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman says talks with US ongoing
english: Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson confirmed that the country is still communicating with the United States. However, he criticized the U.S. for damaging the potential for successful diplomacy through recent military actions. He emphasized that Iran's current primary focus is on protecting its national sovereignty and territorial safety.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ ከአሜሪካ ጋር የሐሳብ ልውውጥ እያደረጉ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። ሆኖም አሜሪካ በወሰደችው የቅርብ ጊዜ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች እንቅፋት መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። የኢራን ዋና ትኩረት በአሁኑ ወቅት የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነትና ግዛት መከላከል መሆኑን አሳውቀዋል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan, biyyi isaanii Ameerikaa waliin walitti dhufeenya fi marii irra akka jiran mirkaneessaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa dhiyeenya kana fudhatteen carraa marii kanaa akka miidhattee fi duula seeraan alaa akka geggeessite himaniiru. Iraan amma xiyyeeffannoo guddaa kan kenniteef mirga abbaa biyyummaa fi nageenya biyya ishee eeggachuuf ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Qatar, Oman foreign ministers discuss US-Iran memorandum
english: The foreign ministers of Qatar and Oman recently held a phone conversation to discuss ways to reduce regional tensions. They emphasized the importance of diplomacy and adhering to the recent US-Iran memorandum. Both officials highlighted the necessity of maintaining stability and ensuring secure navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa Qatar fi Oman walitti buiinsa naannichaa hir'isuuf marii bilbilaan taasisaniiru. Gaggeessitoonni kunneen mariifi diplomaasii fayyadamuun akkasumas walii galtee Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhame kabajuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, daandii bishaan Hormuz keessatti nagayaan socho'uun mirkanaa'uu qaba jedhaniiru.

title: Trump’s border czar probes possible vetting failures after ICE shooting
english: US border czar Tom Homan is investigating whether vetting procedures failed after an ICE officer with a history of mental health and violence issues was involved in a deadly shooting in Maine. This incident has raised concerns about the rapid hiring and training of new agents tasked with carrying out President Trump’s strict immigration enforcement policies. In response, officials have ordered that body cameras must now be used during all vehicle stops to increase accountability.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የድንበር አስተዳዳሪ ቶም ሆማን፣ በአእምሮ ጤና እና በኃይል አድራጊነት ታሪክ የነበረው የኢሚግሬሽን መኮንን ሜይን ግዛት ውስጥ ገዳይ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ውስጥ መግባቱን ተከትሎ፣ የቅጥር ማጣሪያ ሂደቱ ጉድለት ነበረበት ወይ የሚለውን እያጣሩ ነው። ይህ ክስተት የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕን ጥብቅ የኢሚግሬሽን ፖሊሲ ለማስፈጸም በችኮላ የተቀጠሩ አዳዲስ መኮንኖች ስልጠና ላይ ጥያቄ አስነስቷል። ለዚህ መፍትሄ እንዲሆን፣ ሁሉም የመኪና ፍተሻዎች በሰውነት ካሜራ እንዲቀረጹ አዲስ መመሪያ ተላልፏል።
oromo: Hogganaan daangaa Ameerikaa Tom Homan, ajajaa ICE tokko kan seenaa rakkoo fayyaa sammuu fi gocha hammeenyaa qabu, yakka ajjeechaa Maine keessatti raawwatamee hordofee qorannoo geggeessaa jira. Dhimmichi kun hojjettoota haaraa duula godaantota ari’uu Trump qindeessuuf ariitiin qacaramanii fi leenji’an irratti shakkii guddaa uumeera. Kana booda akkaataa hojii fooyyessuuf, yeroo konkolaataan dhaabamu hundi kaameraa qaamaa (body camera) fayyadamuun dirqama ta’eera.

title: What’s causing the unprecedented wildfires in Europe?
english: Parts of Western and Southern Europe are currently facing severe and record-breaking wildfires, with France and Spain being particularly affected. The World Health Organization identifies climate change, characterized by frequent heatwaves and rising temperatures, as the primary factor driving these intense fires. In response, local authorities have mobilized large teams of firefighters and requested international support to help contain the crisis.
amharic: በአውሮፓ ምዕራባዊ እና ደቡባዊ ክፍሎች እጅግ አደገኛ እና ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የደን ቃጠሎ ተከስቷል፣ በተለይም ፈረንሳይ እና ስፔን ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት እንዳለው ከሆነ፣ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ያስከተለው ተደጋጋሚ የሙቀት መጠን መጨመር ለዚህ ቃጠሎ መባባስ ዋና ምክንያት ነው። ችግሩን ለመቆጣጠርም አገራቱ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞችን በማሰማራት ከአጎራባች አገራት የርዳታ ድጋፍ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kutaa dhihaa fi kibba Awurooppaa keessatti ibidda bosonaa cimaa fi kanaan dura hin mul'anne humnatti jira, keessattuu biyyoonni Faransaayii fi Ispeen miidhaa guddaaf saaxilamaniiru. Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa akka ibsetti, jijjiirramni qilleensaa fi hoo'i lafaa dabaluun isaa ibiddoonni kun akka hammatan taasiseera. Rakkoo kana to'achuuf mootummoonni biyyoota kanaa, waraana dhaamsituu ibiddaa kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman bobbaasanii fi biyyoota ollaa irraa gargaarsa gaafachaa jiru.

title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz cannot be used to harm its security
english: Iran's foreign ministry has stated that the Strait of Hormuz will not be allowed to serve as a means for hostile parties to threaten the nation's security. Officials also criticized the United States for not releasing frozen Iranian assets as previously expected. Currently, international mediators like Qatar and Pakistan are working to facilitate communication between the two countries.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአገሪቱን ደህንነት ለመጉዳት በሚፈልጉ ወገኖች መጠቀም እንደማይቻል አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ አሜሪካ የታገዱ የኢራን ንብረቶችን ባለመፍታቷ ተችተዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት እንደ ኳታር እና ፓኪስታን ያሉ አደራዳሪዎች በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ውይይት እንዲኖር ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimma alaa Iraan akka jedhutti, daandiin galaana Hormuz qaamolee biyya isaa miidhuu barbaadan irraa eegamuu qaba jedheera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa kunneen Ameerikaan qabeenya Iraan kan isheen itti hidhe gadi lakkisuu dhabuu ishee balaaleffataniiru. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, biyyoonni giddu-galeessa ta'an kanneen akka Kaataar fi Paakistaan marii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Trump shares AI-generated images targeting Iran, Kharg Island
english: Former President Donald Trump recently posted artificial intelligence-produced pictures on his social media site. These images illustrate hypothetical scenarios involving an attack on Iran's Kharg oil terminal and the capture of an Iranian oil vessel. The posts have drawn attention due to their depiction of aggressive military actions against Iranian infrastructure.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የተፈጠሩ ምስሎችን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ገጻቸው ላይ ለጥፈዋል። ምስሎቹ ኢራን ውስጥ የሚገኘው የካርግ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን እና አንድ የኢራን የነዳጅ መርከብ መያዙን የሚያሳዩ ናቸው። እነዚህ ምስሎች በኢራን መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ የጦርነት ሁኔታዎችን የሚስሉ በመሆናቸው ትኩረት ስበዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp suuraalee teeknooloojii 'AI' fayyadamuun tolfaman miidiyaa hawaasummaa isaanii irratti maxxansaniiru. Suuraaleen kun buufata boba'aa Iran kan Kharg jedhamu irratti haleellaan raawwatamuu fi markibni boba'aa Iran tokko qabamuu kan agarsiisanidha. Suuraaleen kun tarkaanfii waraanaa Iran irratti fudhatamuu danda'u fakkeessuudhaan xiyyeeffannoo horataniiru.

title: PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
english: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has reaffirmed the UK's strong commitment to Ukraine as he prepares to host President Volodymyr Zelensky for his first official international visit. During the meeting, the UK will share the intellectual property for its 'Stone Cloak' electronic warfare technology to help Ukraine produce it domestically. The leaders will also visit a naval base to engage with Ukrainian troops who are currently participating in maritime training exercises in Britain.
amharic: ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ዩክሬን ለሚገኘው የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ለሚያደርጉት የመጀመሪያ ይፋዊ ጉብኝት አቀባበል በማድረግ የእንግሊዝን የጽኑ ድጋፍ አረጋግጠዋል። በጉብኝቱ ወቅት እንግሊዝ የዩክሬን የኤሌክትሮኒክስ ጦርነት አቅምን ለማሳደግ የ'ስቶን ክሎክ' ቴክኖሎጂን በጋራ ለማምረት የሚያስችለውን እውቀት ታካፍላለች። በተጨማሪም መሪዎቹ በብሪታንያ የባህር ኃይል ልምምድ ላይ እየተሳተፉ የሚገኙ የዩክሬን ወታደሮችን ይጎበኛሉ።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Andy Burnham gara biyyaa dhufuuf kan qophaa'aa jiru Pireezidaant Volodymyr Zelenskyiif deeggarsa cimaa Ingiliiziin Yukreeniif qabdu irra deebi'anii mirkaneessaniiru. Marii isaanii kana irratti, Ingiliiziin teeknoolojii waraana elektirooniksii 'Stone Cloak' jedhamu Yukreen ofii ishii akka oomishituuf hayyamaafi beekumsa isaa qooduuf karoorfateera. Dabalataanis, murni kun buufata dooniiwwan waraanaa kan daawwatan yoo ta'u, leenjii waraana galaanaa biyyattii keessatti hirmaachaa jiran waraana Yukreen waliin ni wal argu.

title: Israeli government nods to international stabilisation force in Gaza
english: The Israeli government has approved the deployment of an international stabilization force to Gaza as part of a U.S.-backed peace agreement. This force, consisting of personnel from selected partner nations, will operate in areas outside direct Israeli military control to support reconstruction and administrative transitions. Despite this development, violence remains a concern, with reports of ongoing casualties following the initial ceasefire agreement.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ በሚካሄድ የሰላም ስምምነት መሰረት አለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ወደ ጋዛ እንዲገባ ፈቅዷል። ይህ ኃይል በእስራኤል ቀጥተኛ ወታደራዊ ቁጥጥር ስር ባልሆኑ አካባቢዎች በመንቀሳቀስ መልሶ ግንባታን እና የአስተዳደር ሽግግርን ይደግፋል። ሆኖም ከተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ በኋላም ጥቃቶች እና የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እንደቀጠለ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el walii galtee nagaa Ameerikaan deggeramu keessatti hirmaachuun, humnoonni tasgabbii idil-addunyaa gara Gaazaatti akka seenan hayyameera. Humnoonni kun naannolee waraana Israa'el kallattiin hin to'atne keessatti hojjechaa, deebisanii ijaaruufi sirna bulchiinsaa jijjiiruu keessatti gargaarsa ni kennu. Ta'us, walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa boodas gochi waraanaafi lubbuu namootaa darbuun itti fufee jira.

title: Palestinians hope international peace force can rebuild Gaza
english: Palestinians in Gaza are optimistic about a proposed international stabilization force entering the region as part of a US-supported ceasefire agreement. Displaced residents believe this mission will be essential for reconstructing their devastated neighborhoods. They hope the intervention will finally allow them to return to their homes after a long period of conflict and displacement.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ በሚደረግ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መሰረት አለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ወደ አካባቢው እንዲገባ መፈቀዱን ተስፋ ሰጪ ሆኖ አግኝተውታል። ተፈናቃዮች ይህ ኃይል የወደመውን ጋዛን እንደገና ለመገንባት እና ለረጅም ጊዜ ከቤት ንብረታቸው ተፈናቅለው የቆዩ ሰዎች ወደ ቀያቸው እንዲመለሱ እንደሚረዳ ያምናሉ።
oromo: Warra Gaaza keessa jiran kan ta'an Falisxiinonni, waligaltee diinagdee dhaabbii waraanaa kan Ameerikaan deggerame keessatti humnoonni tasgabbeessitoota idil-addunyaa gara naannichaatti akka seenan hayyamamuun isaanii abdii guddaa kenneefii jira. Namoonni buqqa'an humnoonni kun Gaaza kan barbadaaye deebisanii ijaaruuf akkasumas namoota yeroo dheeraaf bakka jireenya isaanii irraa godaananii turan deebisanii qubachiisuuf shoora guddaa akka taphatan abdatu.

title: US and Iran hit pause on strikes for second day
english: The United States and Iran have paused military strikes for two consecutive days following a period of intense conflict. This de-escalation comes as international mediators from nations like Oman, Qatar, and Pakistan work to encourage diplomatic negotiations. While both countries remain cautious, they are currently prioritizing discussions regarding regional maritime security over further military action.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች ለሁለት ተከታታይ ቀናት መቆማቸው ተሰምቷል። ይህ ውጥረት የመቀነስ እርምጃ የመጣው እንደ ኦማን፣ ኳታር እና ፓኪስታን ያሉ አገራት መካከለኛ በመሆን ድርድር እንዲጀመር ጥረት በማድረጋቸው ነው። ሁለቱም አገራት አሁንም ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አቋም ቢይዙም፣ በአሁኑ ሰዓት ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ይልቅ በባህር ዳርቻ ደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመወያየት ቅድሚያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Iraan waldhabdee waraanaa booda guyyoota lamaaf haleellaa dhaabanii jiru. Tasgabbii kana kan fiede gargaarsa biyyoota akka Omaan, Qatar fi Paakistaan kanneen marii fiiddeebisuuf yaalii taasisanii dha. Biyyoonni lamaanuu of eeggannoo cimaa qabaatanis, ammaaf haleellaa waraanaa irra marii idilee irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru.

title: Former President Hernandez returns to Honduras after Trump pardon
english: Former Honduran President Juan Orlando Hernandez has returned home following a presidential pardon from Donald Trump, which overturned his 45-year US prison sentence for drug trafficking. Although Trump claimed Hernandez was framed by the previous administration, the former leader still faces separate fraud and money-laundering charges in Honduras. Local human rights activists have expressed concern that his upcoming trial might be compromised and that he will ultimately avoid facing true accountability.
amharic: የሆንዱራስ የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ሁዋን ኦርላንዶ ሄርናንዴዝ በአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በተሰጣቸው ይቅርታ ከእስር ተፈተው ወደ ሀገራቸው ተመልሰዋል። ሄርናንዴዝ በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር ወንጀል ተፈርዶባቸው የነበረውን የ45 ዓመት እስራት ትራምፕ እንዲሰረዝ አድርገዋል። ምንም እንኳን ይቅርታ ቢደረግላቸውም፣ በሆንዱራስ በሌሎች የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀሎች ክስ ስለሚጠብቃቸው ለፍርድ ይቀርባሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ይሁን እንጂ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ይህ የሆንዱራስ የፍርድ ሂደት አሳማኝ ላይሆን እንደሚችል በመጋለጥ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin duraanii Honduraas Juan Orlando Hernandez, pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Donald Traampin dhiifama waan argataniif hidhaa waggaa 45 kan qoricha sammua namaa hadoochu seeraan alaa gurguruun itti murtaa'ee ture irraa gadhiifamanii gara biyya isaanii deebi'aniiru. Traamp himanni kun mootummaa duraatiin kan qophaa'e akka ta'e dubbatanis, Hernandez amma biyya isaatti himata malaammaltummaa fi qabeenya seeraan alaa dhiheessuun himatamuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, ogeeyyonni mirga namoomaa fi aktivistoonni himanni kun qulqulluun akka hin taane fi Hernandez adabbii tokko malee akka hafan sodaatu.

title: Houthis claim Saudi drone downed over northwestern Yemen
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have reported that they successfully shot down a Saudi Arabian surveillance drone in the northwestern part of the country. The group provided video evidence showing the remains of the destroyed aircraft. This incident occurred shortly after the Houthis announced that they had carried out strikes against Saudi oil infrastructure.
amharic: በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሀገሪቱ ሰሜን ምዕራብ ክፍል የሳውዲ አረቢያን የስለላ ድሮን መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ የድሮኑን ስብርባሪ የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ጥቃቱ የሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎችን ማጥቃታቸውን ካስታወቁ ከአንድ ቀን በኋላ የተፈጸመ ነው።
oromo: Humni Houthi kan Yaman keessatti argamu, xiyyaara malee kan sa'udii arabiya ta'e tokko gara kaaba-dhiha biyyattitti akka buusan beeksisaniiru. Gareen kun ragaa suuraa fi viidiyoo xiyyaarichi gubachuu isaa agarsiisu gadhiiseera. Gochi kun erga gareen Houthi bakkeewwan oomisha boba'aa Sa'udii irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsanii guyyaa tokko booda kan raawwatame dha.

title: Tunisia: Ghannouchi’s daughter says family denied information after his collapse in prison
english: Rached Ghannouchi, the 84-year-old leader of Tunisia's Ennahda party, has been denied family visits and medical updates after collapsing in prison due to extreme heat. His daughter, Soumaya Ghannouchi, reports that authorities have blocked lawyers and family members from seeing him at the hospital where he was reportedly transferred. She has accused the government of endangering his life by detaining a man with serious health conditions in harsh, uncooled prison conditions.
amharic: የቱኒዚያው የኤናህዳ ፓርቲ መሪ ራሺድ ጋኑቺ በእስር ቤት በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ምክንያት ከወደቁ በኋላ ቤተሰቦቻቸው እና ጠበቆቻቸው ስለጤንነታቸው ምንም አይነት መረጃ እንዳያገኙ ተከልክለዋል። ልጃቸው ሱማያ ጋኑቺ እንዳሉት፣ አባታቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል ቢዛወሩም ባለሥልጣናቱ ቤተሰቡ እንዳያያቸው ከልክለዋል። በተለያዩ የጤና እክሎች የሚሰቃዩት የ84 ዓመቱ ጋኑቺ፣ በቂ የአየር ማቀዝቀዣ በሌለበት እስር ቤት መቆየታቸው ለሕይወታቸው ከፍተኛ ስጋት መሆኑን ቤተሰቦቻቸው ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan paartii Ennahda kan Tuuniziyaa Raashiid Ghaannuuchi, mana hidhaa keessatti hoo'a cimaan erga dhukkubsatanii booda maatiin isaanii waa'ee fayyaa isaanii akka hin beekne dhorkamaniiru. Intalli isaanii Suumayyaa Ghaannuuchi akka jettetti, abbaan isaanii gara hospitaalaatti kan geessaman ta'us, abbootiin seeraa fi maatiin akka isaanii hin argine mootummaan dhoorkeera. Ghaannuuchi umrii isaanii 84 fi dhukkuba fayyaa adda addaa qabanirraayyuu, mana hidhaa hoo'a cimaa fi qabbana hin qabne keessa jiraachuun isaanii lubbuu isaanii balaaf saaxilaa akka jiru maatiin isaanii himaniiru.

title: What lies ahead for Iran’s economy as scope of US war grows beyond Hormuz?
english: The ongoing conflict involving Iran and the U.S. has caused significant instability in key maritime trade routes, affecting both global oil markets and Iran's domestic economy. While mediated talks have provided some temporary relief, the U.S. naval blockade continues to threaten Iran's crucial oil export revenues, which are vital for its budget. Consequently, the Iranian government is facing mounting economic pressure, including the difficult prospect of increasing domestic fuel prices amid widespread public frustration.
amharic: በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ግጭት በዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ መስመሮች ላይ ከፍተኛ አለመረጋጋትን በመፍጠር በነዳጅ ገበያው እና በኢራን ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ጫና አሳድሯል። በሽምግልና የተደረጉ ንግግሮች ጊዜያዊ መፍትሄ ቢሰጡም፣ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ማገጃ የኢራንን ዋና የገቢ ምንጭ የሆነውን የነዳጅ ንግድ አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል። በዚህም ምክንያት የኢራን መንግስት በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ካለው ከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነት እና ህዝባዊ ቅሬታ ጋር ተዳምሮ የነዳጅ ዋጋን የመጨመርን የመሳሰሉ ከባድ ውሳኔዎችን ለመወሰን ተገዷል።
oromo: Gonkii Iran fi US gidduutti itti fufe kun karaalee daldala galaana irraa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuun, gabaa boba'aa addunyaa fi diinagdee Iran irratti dhiibbaa uumeera. Mariin giddu-galeessummaan gaggeeffamu furmaata yeroo gabaabaa kenne iyyuu, duulli itti-hiibba galaanaatiin US geggeessitu gurgurtaa boba'aa Iran kan biyyattii itti fayyadamtuuf soda guddaa ta'eera. Kanaafuu, mootummaan Iran rakkoo diinagdee cimaa keessa jiraachuun, mufii ummataa waliin walqabatee gatii boba'aa biyya keessaa dabaluu dabalatee murtoowwan ulfaatoo ta'an fudhachuuf dirqameera.

title: Al-Sharaa outlines Syria’s approach to security with Israel and Lebanon
english: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa announced that his government is actively pursuing a security deal with Israel. Regarding Lebanon, he clarified that Damascus will not send military forces but will instead help the nation address its ongoing challenges. These statements highlight a shift in Syria's regional diplomatic strategy concerning its neighbors.
amharic: የሶሪያው ፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ሶሪያ ከእስራኤል ጋር የፀጥታ ስምምነት ለማድረግ እየሰራች መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። በሊባኖስ ጉዳይ ላይም ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነት እንደማያደርጉ በመግለጽ፣ በምትኩ አገሪቱ ካለችበት ቀውስ እንድትወጣ ድጋፍ እንደሚያደርጉ ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የሶሪያን የክልላዊ ዲፕሎማሲ አቅጣጫ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Sooriyaa Ahimad Al-Sharaa mootummaan isaanii Israaʼel waliin waliigaltee nageenyaa gochuuf hojjechaa akka jiru ibsan. Dhimma Libaanoos irrattis, biyyi isaanii humna waraanaa akka hin ergine fi rakkoo biyyattiin keessa jirtu akka furattu gargaarsa akka gootan beeksisan. Ibsi kun jijjiirama siyaasaa alaa Sooriyaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: 46 people rescued from sunken ship in South China Sea
english: A total of 46 individuals were safely recovered after their Vietnamese boat went down in the South China Sea. Rescue teams successfully pulled the passengers from the water following the maritime accident. Authorities are managing the situation as the survivors receive necessary assistance.
amharic: በደቡብ ቻይና ባህር ውስጥ የቪየትናም መርከብ በመስጠሟ 46 ሰዎች በህይወት ተረፈዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አደጋው በደረሰበት አካባቢ በመገኘት ተሳፋሪዎቹን ከውሃ ውስጥ ማውጣት ችለዋል። የተረፉት ሰዎች አስፈላጊውን ድጋፍ እያገኙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dooniin Viyeetnaam tokko garba Chaayinaa kibbaatti gadi lixeen wal qabatee, namoonni 46 lubbuun oorfamaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa balaa kana booda namoota bishaan keessa turan kana baasuu danda'aniiru. Namootni lubbuun hafan kunis gargaarsa barbaachisu argachaa jiru.

title: Cuban president accuses US of genocide, seeking takeover
english: Cuban President Miguel Diaz-Canel has publicly accused the United States of committing genocide and attempting to take control of his country. This follows an ongoing oil embargo and severe economic sanctions imposed by Washington, which have triggered widespread power outages and critical resource shortages across the island. The Cuban leader claims these aggressive measures are intended to stifle the nation’s economy and force a political takeover.
amharic: የኩባው ፕሬዚዳንት ሚጌል ዲያዝ-ካኔል አሜሪካ በሀገራቸው ላይ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል እየፈጸመች እና አገሪቱን ለመቆጣጠር እየሞከረች ነው ሲሉ ከሰሱ። ይህ የተባለው ዋሽንግተን በጣለችው የነዳጅ ማዕቀብ እና በሌሎች የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች ሳቢያ በኩባ ውስጥ የከፋ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እና የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮ እጥረት መፈጠሩን ተከትሎ ነው። የኩባ መሪ እንደገለጹት እነዚህ ጫናዎች የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ በማዳከም በሕዝቡ ላይ የፖለቲካ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ የሚደረግ ጥረት ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Kuubaa Miigeel Diyaaz-Kaaneel, Ameerikaan biyya isaa irratti sanyii balleessuu raawwachaa fi biyyattii to'achuuf yaalaa jirti jechuun himatan. Himannaan kun kan dhufe erga Waashingitan daangaa boba'aa fi adabbii dinagdee cimaa biyyattii irratti kaastee booda, ergaa sanaan walqabatee rakkoon elektirikii fi hir'inni meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an biyyattii keessatti babal'achuu isaatiin walqabata. Hogganaan Kuubaa akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiiwwan kun kanneen dinagdee biyyattii laamsheessuun uummata gidirsuu fi biyyattii to'annoo isaanii jala galchuuf karoorfaman dha.

title: Netanyahu vows to go to New York City despite ICC arrest warrant, Mamdani
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has announced his plan to speak at the United Nations in New York City, openly defying an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court. During a television interview, he criticized New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani for his pro-Palestinian stance and suggestions that the Prime Minister should be arrested upon arrival. Despite Netanyahu’s accusations against the mayor, recent polling suggests that a significant number of American Jewish adults hold a more favorable view of Mamdani than they do of Netanyahu.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በዓለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት የወጣባቸውን የእስር ትእዛዝ ችላ በማለት በኒውዮርክ በሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ዋና መስሪያ ቤት ንግግር እንደሚያደርጉ አስታውቀዋል። ኔታንያሁ ለኒውዮርክ ከንቲባ ዞህራን ማምዳኒ በሰነዘሩት ትችት፣ ከንቲባው እሱን በመቃወም ጥላቻን እያነሳሱ ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። ሆኖም በቅርቡ የተደረጉ ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ አሜሪካ ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ብዙ አይሁዳውያን ስለ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ካላቸው አስተያየት ይልቅ ስለ ከንቲባው ያላቸው አመለካከት በጎ እንደሆነ ያመለክታል።
oromo: Muummee ministira Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahuun, ajaja hidhaa Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa irraa isaan irratti darbe osoo hin hubatin, magaala Niiw Yoorkitti argamuun waldaa mootummoota gamtoomaniitti haasawa akka godhan beeksisaniiru. Netanyaahuun kantiibaa magaala Niiw Yoorki Zooraan Maamdaanii, deeggarsa isaanii kan Falasxiinootaaf qaban fi yaada isaan ajaja hidhaa kana deggeran irratti hundaauun, kantiibichi jibba babal'isaa jiru jechuun qeequ. Ta'us, qorannoon dhiheenya kana taasifame akka agarsiisutti, namoonni Yuudii Ameerikaa keessa jiraatan baay'een isaanii Netanyaahuu caalaatti kantiibaa Zooraan Maamdaanii akka deggeran ifa godheera.
